publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In recent years, the use of terahertz waves with frequencies ranging from 100 GHz to 1 THz has been considered for ultrafast wireless communications and high-resolution sensing. There, it is important to control the wavefront of the transmitted signals. However, the use of dielectric materials faces a challenge that dielectric losses increase with the frequency. To circumvent this challenge, it has recently been demonstrated to implement distributed effective refractive index inside a pair of metal plates by spatially varying the distance between the plates, thereby realizing a terahertz lens without using dielectrics [1]. However, that design is valid only at a certain frequency, and it works just approximately in other frequencies. Therefore, it is difficult to ensure broadband capability. In this study, we try to reconcile dielectric-free refractive index distribution and broad bandwidth by numerically optimizing the effective refractive index between the metal plates based on topology optimization [2].

articleTitle: Chip-Size Resonant-Tunneling-Diode Oscillator as a FMCW and OCT Source
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a chip-size source for FMCW (frequency-modulated continues-wave) radar and frequency-domain OCT (optical coherence tomography) in the sub-THz range. As the source, we use resonant-tunneling-diode patch-antenna oscillators, creating a true chip-size source operating at 680 GHz with an output power of $23 \ {\mu} \mathrm{W}$. A linearized frequency chirp with a bandwidth of 38 GHz (5.5 %) and 4 mm spatial resolution is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Volumetric Method of Moments for Integrated Lens Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A Volumetric Method of Moments accelerated by means of iterative solvers combined with FFT matrix-vector products has been presented. The method allows analyzing small lens antennas with their integrated feeds efficiently since different structures and geometries can be studied with the same discretization, just by adding the material characteristics in post-processing.

articleTitle: Characterization of Si Epitaxial Layer grown on highly-doped Si substrate by using THz reflection spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Properties of Si epitaxial layer with thinner thickness than 6um and doping concentration of1014 to $10^{16}/\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}^{3}$, grown on highly doped Si substrate, were analyzed by time domain THz reflection spectroscopy. For improving the measurement resolutions, photo-excitation technique was applied on this spectroscopy. And we could obtain the epilayer properties with resolutions of 0.1um in thickness and $10^{15}/\mathrm{c}\mathrm{m}^{3}$ in doping concentration.

articleTitle: Quantitative detection of solid sialic acid using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Sialic acid is one of the key constituents in tumor-specific glycans and an important biomarker for a diversity of cancer types. Its content change in the blood serum can be used for early diagnosis of cancer, grading of cancer, and evaluation of therapeutic effect and prognosis. In this paper, we studied and analyzed the terahertz (THz) response of solid sialic acid samples with five concentrations. Based on the characteristics of the peak value among absorption coefficient spectrum, linear fitting is performed to achieve the quantitative detection of sialic acid.

articleTitle: Current-driven THz emission from AlGaN/GaN grating gate structures in the magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: THz radiation emission from electrically excited AlGaN/GaN heterostructures with metal grating gate couplers was experimentally studied in the magnetic field. Special emphasis was paid to the technology and fabrication of the high quality AlGaN/GaN plasmonic structures with two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) integrated with high active area metal surface grating. The THz emission peaks related to 2D plasmons were observed with and without a magnetic field. The positions of THz emission peaks and their dependence on the magnetic field are in agreement with the 2D plasmon resonances. The results pave the way toward new voltage-controlled sources of THz radiation.

articleTitle: Sheet Resistance Imaging on Ag Thin Films with THz-TDS in Reflection Geometry
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present sheet resistance imaging of silver (Ag) thin films on a $\sim 50 \ \mu \mathrm{m} -$thick dielectric layer on a plane steel substrate. THz imaging avoids damaging these films through contacting and allows for a high spatial resolution. We use a commercial THz time-domain spectroscopy system in reflection geometry. Our measurement data are interpreted by a least squares fit to a simple model of the frequency response of the layer stack based on Fresnel equations and the Drude model. The analysis reveals the thickness of the dielectric and the Ag-layer as well as the dielectric function of the Ag-layer. By raster-scanning the sample, spatially-resolved sheet resistance maps are non-destructively generated.

articleTitle: Stimulated polariton scattering gain modelling for MgO:LiNbO3 with low-frequency excitations
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a detailed approach to predicting Stokes gain for stimulated polariton scattering in MgO:LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> using a gain theory for Gaussian beams that also accounts for the effects of increased polariton damping in the low-frequency wing of the 248 c$\mathrm{m}^{-1}A_{1}$ phonon line. The new theory with the corrected absorption coefficient provides the most accurate route for modelling the gain that applies to real experimental conditions.

articleTitle: Refractive Index Extraction from THz-TDS Measurement with the Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The complex refractive index for optically thick low-loss materials is conventionally extracted via iterative algorithm based on the transmission-mode terahertz time domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS). Without assigning initial values, a new approach based on the neural network was investigated to obtain the optical parameters for three typical materials (TPX, quartz and SiC) in the THz frequency range. Comparisons with the iterative method were conducted. The neural network method is also expected to find applications in characterization of the two-dimensional material (like graphene) and the multilayer material system.

articleTitle: Terahertz Field Spatiotemporal Superfocusing in Complex Media
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a theoretical/experimental framework to demonstrate spatiotemporal superfocusing (SF) and field-modulation of ultrafast terahertz (THz) waves in scattering media. We show that THz state of the art time-domain technology provides the access the full-wave control of the electromagnetic radiation. The majority of the work in this topic were performed in the optical-regime, where the measurement of fields and phases is very challenging, these results did not, as yet, exploit the full-wave properties, something that can be obtained when the transmitted field is collected by a time-domain setup. We suggest the possibility for exploring new potential THz applications for developing novel imaging technologies.

articleTitle: Image denoising algorithm for millimeter wave imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a denoising method for active millimeter wave (mmWave) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging system is proposed based on quadratic template matching and stable variance variation. In order to eliminate the background noise while preserving the details of the main part, we use the result of distance regularized level set evolution (DRLSE) as a primary template for background filtering, and then use the result of background filtering as a secondary template. In order to eliminate the mixed Poisson-Gaussian noise in the image, we transform the noise data into an approximate uniform Gaussian distribution by variance-stabilizing transform (VST), and then use the improved wavelet threshold denoising (WTD) to denoise the data. The experimental results reveal that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Impact of Bias Field Screening and Dipole Length in Terahertz Photoconductive Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A numerical approach for the modelling of dipole Photoconductive Antennas (PCAs) is presented, based on the classical Drude model with extension to include the bias field screening due to both the space charge and the THz radiation fields. By employing a fixed-point iterative algorithm, good computational efficiency and convergence are obtained for typical PCA configuration parameters. Results unveiling the role played by each of the different phenomena and the radiated THz spectra for different dipole lengths are shown and discussed.

articleTitle: High harmonic generation in Mott-insulating Ca2RuO4
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We observed high harmonic generation in Mott-insulating Ca<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>RuO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, and found an empirical scaling law of high harmonic yields. A theoretical model considering the spin-charge effect and thermal fluctuation qualitatively reproduces the observed scaling law. Our observation and calculation indicate that high harmonic generation can be a new tool to investigate ultrafast non-equilibrium dynamics of the strongly correlated system.

articleTitle: Closed-Loop Graphene-FET for High Harmonics THz Emission
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Graphene devices are known to have the potential to detect, generate, and manipulate THz radiation. In particular, graphene field-effect transistors have been proposed as suitable devices to host plasmonic instabilities that lead to the emission of THz; for instance, Dyakonov-Shur instability which relies upon direct current excitation. In our work, we propose a closed-loop scheme with positive feedback, in which a fraction of the source current is added to the imposed drain current. Thus, our simulations show that such mechanism can achieve faster saturation of the unstable modes, and, more importantly, an order of magnitude increase in the power of the higher modes.

articleTitle: Precise tracking of water ingress through film coated pharmaceutical tablets using terahertz pulsed imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz pulsed imaging (TPI) was used to visualize the live liquid penetration process of film-coated pharmaceutical tablets. Multiple features are observed including diffusion through both coating and core layer, with a discontinuity at the core-coating interface. They can be conveniently quantified and related back to the parameters in the manufacturing process. This study has the potential to facilitate a more in-depth understanding of the impact of coating on drug dissolution.

articleTitle: Metamaterial Design Using Distributed Neural Network (DiNN) Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We propose a novel Distributed Neural Network (DiNN) approach for the design of Metamaterial which doesn’t require a high computational facility, with a faster training process and high accuracy with 95% of mean square error (MSE) below $4.6x10^{-4}$.

articleTitle: High power polarization-insensitive InGaAs-based Photomixer with extended metallic contact for THz communication systems
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This work proposes and simulates a high-power polarization-insensitive InGaAs-based continuous-wave THz emitter. The mesh-like metallic contacts in the suggested structure significantly improve the transmission of the incident optical pump to the active region. The carefully designed metallic features substantially enhance the local bias field near contact edges where the majority of photoexcited carriers are formed. Furthermore, by the contribution of the extended metallic contacts, the photogenerated carriers effectively reach the contacts and lead to 10 times higher THz radiation compared to the structure without extended metallic contacts. The proposed structure generates identical THz photocurrent under different polarization of optical pump. This advantage makes it a great candidate for THz communication, which system’s robustness is crucial to environmental change. The simulation results indicate that under 240 mW unpolarized optical pump power, the optimized structure radiates 561 $\mu$W power at 500 GHz frequency.

articleTitle: A wavefront measurement platform for W band microwave
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The accurate wavefront measurement is an essential prerequisite for the successful two-dimensional microwave imaging reflectometer (MIR) application on tokamaks. An integrated platform for automatic and accurate measurement of the wavefront has been developed, which is specifically applied to the MIR system on EAST tokamak.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigation of the Bias-path Model for the Photocurrent in Photoconductive Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Numerical results on the implementation of a computationally efficient algorithm for finding the instantaneous photocurrent across the gap volume in Photoconductive antennas (PCAs) through solution of one-dimensional (1D) drift-diffusion equations along the bias field lines are presented. Excellent agreement with a reference two-dimensional (2D) numerical algorithm is found and the relative error is seen to decrease with the number of lines used in the computation.

articleTitle: Spintronic terahertz emitters exploiting uniaxial magnetic anisotropy for field-free emission and polarization control
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on the terahertz (THz) emission from CoFeB/Pt spintronic structures in the below-magnetic-saturation regime and enhance the in-plane uniaxial magnetic anisotropy (UMA) in the ferromagnetic layer by varying the sputter deposition conditions. In the case of a ferromagnetic film with a well-defined UMA, we demonstrate that alignment of the applied magnetic field with the easy axis of the structure allows the THz emission to reach saturation under weaker applied magnetic fields. Furthermore, in this orientation the THz emission remains at saturation levels with the magnetic field subsequently removed, thus realizing field-free THz emission from a simple spintronic bilayer structure. In addition, we demonstrate that the UMA in the ferromagnetic layer can be exploited to enable control of the polarization of the emitted THz pulse. By applying the magnetic field along the hard axis of the structure, we achieve rotation of the plane of linear polarization by modulating the magnitude of the applied field.

articleTitle: On the Tunability of Mode Locked Laser Diodes for Use as Local Oscillators in Photonic Terahertz Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: To enable the application of new as well as established measurement techniques in the field of terahertz technology based on monolithically integrated mode-locked laser diodes (MLLDs), the control of several parameters and laser characteristics must be investigated. Therefore, this work shows an in-depth investigation of two similar quantum dot (QD) MLLDs with respect to their repetition rate and repetition rate stability. After determining the best operating points, we show an experiment where both lasers are used for the generation and detection of terahertz signals without a physical link connecting any part of the system.

articleTitle: Curved Leaky-Wave Antennas for Terahertz Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Conformal antennas are required for next generation of wireless systems combining the use of high frequency bands (terahertz) with smart interconnected devices (the Internet of Things). Here, we study and demonstrate curved terahertz leaky-wave antennas. We also demonstrate data transmission using a multibeam conformal antenna.

articleTitle: Data Mining for Terahertz Generation Crystals
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Non-centrosymmetric molecular crystals are effective in nonlinear optical applications, such as second-harmonic generation, and optical rectification, due to low dielectric constants and high molecular hyperpolarizabilities. We designed a combined method of data mining for non-centrosymmetric structure from the Cambridge Structural Database (CSD) and performing density functional theory calculations to discover new organic nonlinear optical crystals that generate intense terahertz (THz) radiation. To confirm our combination approach, we recrystallized and tested the newly discovered organic nonlinear materials. The results of THz experiments showed the THz generation capabilities are comparable to state-to-art THz generation crystals (DAST, OH-1 and BNA).

articleTitle: Sub-cycle high-order nonlinearities in a terahertz quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Ultrafast electron dynamics in quantum cascade lasers hold enormous potential for the implementation of intense, compact mode-locked terahertz sources, squeezed terahertz light, frequency mixers, and comb-based metrology systems. Yet the important sub-cycle dynamics have been notoriously difficult to access in operational terahertz quantum cascade lasers. Here we show the first field-resolved two-dimensional terahertz spectroscopy of a free-running quantum cascade laser, revealing its sub-cycle gain dynamics and disentangling resonantly enhanced high-order nonlinearities up to eight-wave mixing in a regime of negative absorption.

articleTitle: Basic study on THz wireless communication using Kerr micro-resonator frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Optical-to-THz conversion of microcomb with uni-traveling-carrier photodiode is a potential method to generate CW-THz wave with ultra-high frequency, low phase noise, and high practicability. In this paper, we demonstrate the THz wireless communication at 560 GHz based on this method.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Shielding for CO2 Laser of Dispersion Interferometer on EAST
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The electromagnetic field environment in the Experimental and Advanced Superconducting Tokamak (EAST) experiment hall is very complex. Especially during plasma discharges, the infrared continuous-wave 9.3 μm CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser source of the dispersive interferometer (DI) system <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> installed in the EAST experiment hall will be disturbed. Therefore, it is important to design a set of electromagnetic shielding device for the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser source. The electromagnetic shielding device has been designed. After testing, it has made an electromagnetic field shielding effect. During the plasma discharge of EAST, the data shows good consistency with the result measured by far-infrared HCN interferometer.

articleTitle: Silicon Integrated Terahertz Quantum Cascade Ring Laser Frequency Comb
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate terahertz quantum cascade lasers realized in defect-free ring resonators that are mounted episide-down on a silicon substrate by a die-bonding technique. Devices show much reduced threshold current densities and free-running comb formation.

articleTitle: Laser Terahertz Emission Nanoscopy with Blue Pump Pulses
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We describe the first demonstration of s-SNOM using blue light. Using femtosecond pulses at 410 nm, we generate THz emission from bulk InAs and show that these near-field signals provide spectroscopic information that cannot be obtained using near-infrared pulses. Next, we generate near-field THz emission images directly from bulk silicon and develop a novel theoretical framework to correlate them directly to the silicon’s local carrier concentration.

articleTitle: A calibration-free method to assess the quality of standards for THz on-wafer measurements
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A method to assess the quality of the calibration standards has been developed and tested. The actual response of the tested transmission lines for LRRM-16 calibration approach has been simulated in HFSS environment, fabricated, and tested with on-wafer measurement setup. The method for quality assessment is based on the properties of similar matrices, that compares traces and determinants of the S-parameters products for fabricated and simulated structures.

articleTitle: Cavity Design and PIC Simulation of 10-kilowatt-level Continuous Wave W-band Sheet Beam Extended Interaction Klystron
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The power capacity of millimeter-wave devices directly limits the ability to operate in continuous waves. Intercept current can be reduced and the power capacity can be increased by the large tunnel size (8mm $\times$ 0.7mm). Analysis of dispersion and parameter optimization improves the effective interaction coefficient. PIC simulation shows that the output is 13.1kW with 0.1W input, and corresponding efficiency is 12.2%. The 1-dB bandwidth is about 100 MHz.

articleTitle: Antenna Integration in sub-Terahertz Radar Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Sub-Terahertz and Terahertz (sub-THz, THz) technologies find application in a large range of areas as communication, imaging, sensing and radar systems. For these applications, sub-Terahertz systems are facing huge challenges in terms of fabrication and integration of antennas together with system components. In this abstract, an overview of different technological choices adopted in the design of 140 GHz and 300 GHz antennas used in radar systems is presented.

articleTitle: Effect of porcine skin components on absorption of THz waves
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The EMF safety in a terahertz (THz) frequency band is described in several reports, but more detailed dielectric properties of tissues are necessary for correct estimation of power absorption in human body. In this study, the absorption coefficients of dermis and epidermis isolated from porcine skin were measured by the THz TD-ATR spectroscopy. The absorption coefficient of dermis was significantly higher than that of epidermis in the 0.3 THz-1.0 THz region. Moreover, our results suggest that the differences in the absorption coefficient depend on the water content as well as biopolymers in tissues.

articleTitle: Extracting Material Properties from a Liquid Crystal Cell Using Terahertz Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Liquid crystal materials that demonstrate birefringence at terahertz frequencies present an opportunity for the development of adaptive terahertz optics. Liquid crystal devices often consist of several optical layers surrounding a thin liquid crystal film, which can make extraction of the material parameters challenging. Using broadband THz spectroscopy, we present a thin-film analysis of a liquid crystal device with a commercially available liquid crystal material (E7), up to 4 THz.

articleTitle: Developing a Si Micromachined Module for a 2 THz Schottky Receiver
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Space instruments to perform measurements in the THz range can provide unique insight into the chemical and physical processes in space, motivating the need to develop key technology components to support this frequency domain. Development of a 2.06 THz receiver, used for the purposes of detecting the ionized oxygen (OI) line, is detailed here, including the process of its design, fabrication, and integration with an advanced local oscillator (LO) chain to support subharmonic mixing.

articleTitle: Terahertz Birefringence and Dichroism in (100) and (111) NdGaO3
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report Terahertz (THz) birefringence and THz dichroism from 0.5THz to 2.5THz in commercial 500 $\mu \mathrm{m}$ thick (100) NdGaO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and (111) NdGaO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> by studying polarization resolved THz Time Domain Spectroscopy (THz-TDS) at room temperature.

articleTitle: THz pulse generation and single shot detection in a single ZnTe Crystal IRMMW- THz 2022
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Single-cycle THz signal of few picoseconds duration, have been simultaneous generated via optical rectification and detected by electro-optic effect in the same ZnTe crystal. An unbalanced seemingly single shot detection scheme was performed to characterize the signal. The added simplicity of this scheme aided the independent analysis of the horizontal and vertical polarization arm of the chirped probe beam to explain the associated nonlinearities in the detected THz signal.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared nanospectroscopy of individual DNA-binding protein oligomers
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Photothermal expansion nanospectroscopy with a tunable mid-infrared quantum cascade laser is employed to acquire the infrared nanospectroscopy spectra of individual oligomers of a DNA-binding protein relevant for neurological diseases. Oligomers down to 100 nm diameter and 10 nm thickness are targeted leveraging on the high lateral resolution provided by the nanospectroscopy approach.

articleTitle: Artificial Dielectric Beam-Scanning Prism for the THz Region
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We design and fabricate an artificial dielectric prism that can steer a THz beam in space and experimentally investigate its behavior. The artificial dielectric medium consists of a uniformly-spaced stack of metal plates. At an operating frequency of 0.3 THz, we observe a maximum beam deflection of 29°, limited by the precision of the available spacers. The very good agreement between the experimental deflection angle and the theoretical prediction strongly indicates the feasibility to practically realize much larger angles. In addition to the obvious practical application, at the fundamental level, this work also demonstrates the feasibility to realize zero-index materials.

articleTitle: Extended modelling of Si CMOS TeraFETs beyond Dyakonov-Shur hydrodynamics
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Field-effect transistors (FETs) are indispensable electronic devices for modern electronic technology. Connected to an external antenna with asymmetric layout, FETs can also be used as THz detectors (TeraFETs). The underlying rectification mechanism in the TeraFETs can be studied theoretically on the basis of a hydrodynamic transport model. Here, we investigate the influence of plasma wave mixing, carrier diffusion and carrier heating on the expected response for a Si CMOS TeraFET.

articleTitle: THz photoconductivity dynamics of semiconductors from sub-nanosecond to millisecond timescales
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The pump-probe delay in optical pump, terahertz probe (OPTP) spectroscopy (time-resolved THz spectroscopy) is typically varied using a mechanical delay stage, which limits the delay range to a few nanoseconds. Here we demonstrate an inexpensive modification to typical OPTP setups that extends the range of pump-probe delays to beyond millisecond timescales, whilst retaining the sub-nanosecond resolution required to resolve faster processes that are often present at early times after pulsed optical excitation. We used this new method to investigate the photoconductance dynamics in a range of materials including IIIV semiconductors, metal halide perovskites, germanium and silicon, whose carrier lifetimes range from a few nanoseconds to milliseconds.

articleTitle: Multiple co-integrated glass lasing structures for THz generation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Lasers on glass exhibit thermal stability and a very narrow linewidth compatible with frequency generation. In this work, we report the fabrication of single-mode co-integrated lasers on the same Er:Yb doped glass substrate. By modifying the laser design, optical frequencies separated by 50 to 280 GHz have can be generated having milli-watts optical power. Such signals can be converted to THz signal using a wide bandwidth photodiode. THz beating frequencies up to 280 GHz are reported in these preliminary results. In this work, we demonstrated the first THz source made of co-integrated Erbium-doped DFB laser. A maximum power of 140 nW at 140.0 GHz was measured, with a conversion efficiency of 7%.

articleTitle: Design of multi-layered radiative cooling structures using evolutionary algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this work we present a novel way to design thin-film radiative cooling metamaterials based on genetic algorithms. Three simulations with different design constraints have been done, resulting in three structures that achieve 39.96 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 57.78W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 61.77 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> under direct sunlight, respectively. These structures are shorter than $5 \mu \mathrm{m}$ of height and are composed of 9, 15 and 24 layers. This design method has the advantages of being automatable, needs fewer design experience in metamaterials and does not rely on commercial simulators. This work opens the path to an easy way of automated design of thin-film multi-layered devices for radiative cooling and other applications in the infrared range.

articleTitle: Design of Terahertz One-dimensional Photonic Crystal Cavity Based on Neural Network and Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Neural networks and optimization algorithms have great potential application in the physical analysis and design of optical components due to their high speed and high efficiency. Taking terahertz (THz) one-dimensional (1D) photonic crystal (PC) resonant cavity as an example, a neural network is proposed to predict the fundamental parameters of the PC cavity with high accuracy. However, the neural network alone suffers from low accuracy in the process of reverse prediction. In combination with a multi-objective optimization algorithm, the reverse prediction of the PC cavity is realized with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Nanoscopy of an Exciton Mott Transition in Twisted Bilayer WSe2
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The density-driven transition of an exciton gas into a plasma of unbound electron-hole pairs has provided a compelling testbed for exploring many-body physics. Here, we use ultrafast polarization nanoscopy to trace a Mott transition of excitons in a twisted bilayer of WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. An initially monomolecular recombination of optically dark excitons continuously evolves into bimolecular recombination of unbound electrons and holes as the density is increased. Furthermore, we reveal directly how the Mott transition varies on nanometer length scales, demonstrating how the technique is indispensable in the study of intrinsically disordered van der Waals materials.

articleTitle: Integrated photonic circuits for terahertz applications
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This talk will discuss recent advances in the nascent field of integrated photonic circuits for terahertz applications. This field explores photonic circuit technology to create miniaturized terahertz emitters and detectors by non-linear optical processes that cannot be realized with other technologies. It leverages the unprecedented design flexibility offered by chip-scale components such as waveguides, resonators and terahertz antennas in combination with low-loss and high-performance nonlinear materials. The talk will concentrate on two of the recently emerging material platforms - thin film lithium niobate and hybrid organics-on-SOI - and elaborate on the fundamental working principles of both high-sensitivity detectors and custom-tailored emitters. Their present and future applications in fundamental research concerning metrology, photon generation and arbitrary waveform synthesis will be discussed.

articleTitle: Surface Roughness Measurement of 3D-Printed 316L Stainless Steel Surface using Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The ultra-rough surface of the 3D-printed metal produced by laser powder bed fusion technique is one of the major challenges faced in commercializing 3D-printed metallic components in a wider context. The electrochemical polishing method is currently considered a promising method to overcome this obstacle. However, evaluating the average roughness of a 3D printed surface before and after polishing with the current state-of-the-art laser scanning microscopy suffers incomplete datasets due to highly scattered signals. Here we successfully evaluate the rms roughness of the metallic surfaces with different roughness levels using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) for comparison against roughness values acquired using a commercial laser scanning microscope.

articleTitle: Comparison of Phase Noise between Mode Spacing in Soliton Microcomb and THz Radiation Generated by Optical-to-THz Conversion of Microcomb
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Optical-to-THz conversion of microcomb with uni-traveling-carrier photodiode is a potential method to generate CW-THz wave with ultra-high frequency, low phase noise, and high practicability. In this paper, we evaluated the phase noise of CW-THz wave at 560 GHz.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Terahertz Generation in Semiconductor Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-thin semiconductor metasurfaces for generation of THz pulses. By investigating the dependence of the THz amplitude and phase on excitation field polarization and crystal orientation, we deduce that the underlying THz emission mechanism in metasurfaces differs from bulk semiconductor wafers with second order nonlinearity playing a dominant role. The metasurface enables control of the THz phase and can therefore be used to spatially structure the THz emitted field. We use this effect to design and demonstrate a metasurface which simultaneously emits and focusses THz pulses.

articleTitle: The Origin of 1.6 Terahertz Absorption of Ice
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In the terahertz spectroscopy of bimolecular solutions, freezing reduces the background absorption. For example, the absorption coefficient of room temperature water is 237 $^{-1}$ at 1 THz, whereas that of ice is 6.8 cm $^{-1}$ at 173 K. Lower background absorption highlights any spectral features originating from the biomolecule. A reliable baseline spectrum of ice is thus crucial. Despite the interest in biomedical applications, theoretical models and experimental data related to ice are still lacking in the literature, thus hindering progress in the cryogenic measurement of biological samples. We previously reported a highly consistent absorption spectrum of ice in the 0.2 to 2 THz range, which has a profile with a noticeable change of gradient at 1.6 THz. This work extends our investigation into the origin of this feature. Specifically, we investigate whether it is due to scattering by air bubbles, or whether it is an inherent nature of the molecular structure of ice.

articleTitle: Towards Continuous Wave, Single Mode, Surface-Emitting Lasers at 24-28μm
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Surface emitting, single mode lasers at wavelengths of 24-28μm are presented. The design based on metal-metal waveguides, thermal bridges and employing planarization technology helps approach continuous wave operation by improving heat dissipation.

articleTitle: Efficient ultrabroad terahertz emission from nanometer-thick spintronic heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Optically excited THz spintronic emitters have become promising THz sources, permitting a gapless broadband spectrum. We experimentally investigate THz spintronic emission based on the spin Hall effect in ferromagnetic/metal heterostructures with different femtosecond pulse excitations. We demonstrate the combination of high efficiencies (>10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>) and ultrabroad emission with a 23 fs high power Ytterbium laser.

articleTitle: Reflectarray as a 2D Dispersive Optic for Dispersive THz Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: For research, the development of a low-cost and lightweight spectroscopy system is of interest. Spectroscopy is the investigation of the absorption and the emission of electromagnetic waves by a material, where the resulting spectrum represents the intensity of the wave as a function of frequency. In this article, we demonstrate the performance of a simple principle of THz spectroscopy, and we show that the data analysis does not require complex signal processing or complex calibration. Combining a CMOS THz camera with a reflectarray enables spatial-spectral mapping of incident THz radiation with an average spatial frequency resolution of about 5 GHz per pixel for a pixel size of 80x80 $\mu m^{2}$ of the receiver, comprising of a 2D array of 32x32 CMOS detector pixels.

articleTitle: Efficient is-TPG spectroscopic system using flat pump beam
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this study, we introduced flat pump beam to realize efficient injection-seeded terahertz (THz) parametric generator (is-TPG). This enabled us to achieve both sufficient power density and the interaction length of the THz-wave, reducing the required pump beam energy by more than 85% compared to the conventional system. The reduction of the oscillation threshold has also made it possible to construct is-TPG spectroscopic system with pump beam of less than 3 mJ.

articleTitle: Terahertz emission characteristics of semi-insulating and low-temperature grown gallium arsenide photoconductive antenna at 780 nm and 1.55μm
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The terahertz (THz) emission from semi-insulating (SI-GaAs) and low-temperature grown gallium arsenide (LTGaAs) photoconductive antenna were measured at above bandgap 780 nm and below bandgap 1.55 $\mu \mathrm{m}$ photoexcitation conditions. The SI-GaAs and LT-GaAs samples have also shown different amplitude and bandwidth characteristics between the two wavelengths. We explain our results in the context of the different THz radiation mechanisms between SI-GaAs and LT-GaAs at below-bandgap excitation. This work provides insights on the possible development of GaAs PCAs for telecommunication wavelength application.

articleTitle: Coherent coupling of a metamaterial resonator with hydrogen-like acceptor impurities in Si
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigate the coherent coupling of metamaterial resonators with hydrogen-like boron acceptors in doped Si at cryogenic temperature. When the resonance frequency of the metamaterial superimposes a transition frequency of the acceptors, Rabi splitting is observed. As expected, the splitting shows a square-root dependence on the density of the acceptors. Our experiments open a new route for the investigation of quantum information processes employing strong coupling of dopants in Si.

articleTitle: Optimizing large-area periodically-poled lithium niobate wafer stacks for high-energy narrowband terahertz generation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigate and optimize sources of high-energy narrowband terahertz (THz) radiation by stacking lithium niobate wafers in a periodically-poled configuration. We explore source performance as a function of wafer number, pump fluence, pump pulse duration and wafer separation, demonstrating the potential for a low-cost, highly-scalable, flexible narrowband THz source.

articleTitle: 8-beam local oscillators multiplexer for GUSTO at 4.7 THz
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We will report a full demonstration of the Fourier phase grating used as 4.7 THz local oscillator (LO) multiplexer for Galactic/Extragalactic ULDB Spectroscopic Terahertz Observatory (GUSTO). The design, modeling, tolerance analysis, and experimental characterization of the angular and intensity distributions among 2 × 4 output beams and the power efficiency will be presented. This is the first detailed study of a THz beam multiplexer, which will be actually integrated in an observatory.

articleTitle: Engineering ultrafast carrier dynamics in GeS: nanostructuring and small molecule intercalation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Germanium sulfide (GeS) is a 2D semiconductor with high carrier mobility and a moderate band gap of about 1.5 eV, which holds promise for high-speed optoelectronics and photovoltaics. We use time-resolved THz spectroscopy to investigate ultrafast carrier dynamics in in GeS single crystals as well as in GeS nanoribbons. In both bulk and nanostructured GeS, we find that near gap excitation at 1.55 eV results in much longer lived photocarriers compared to 3.1 eV excitation. We also explore how intercalation of small molecules influences the photoexcited carrier dynamics in GeS. We find that presence of edge states in nanoribbons results in decreased carrier lifetime. Organic molecules such as octylamine, which do not form chemical bonds with the host GeS layers, increase photoexcited carrier lifetime. These findings demonstrate the possibility of engineering the properties of 2D materials by intercalation.

articleTitle: Non-linear impairments of 300 GHz MPAs for THz communications
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper we report on the use of THz photonics techniques to evaluate the impairments induced by non-linear behavior of 300 GHz amplifier blocks. Using a referenced THz photonics IQ generator, the error-vector magnitude evolution is analyzed towards optimum power operation point of the amplifier.

articleTitle: Terahertz Spectroscopy and Crystal Structure Analysis of Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drug Ethenzamide Cocrystals
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Two cocrystals of ethenzamide (ETZ) with 2,6-dihydroxybenzoic acid (26DHBA) and 2,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid (24DHBA) were synthesized by the solvent evaporation method. All the cocrystals were characterized by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS), and the crystal structures were determined by density functional theory (DFT) calculations. The THz spectra showed that there were different characteristic peaks between two original components and the cocrystals. The DFT results about the crystal structure analysis of two cocrystals revealed that the position of hydroxyl groups in the coformers plays an important role in the formation of specific supramolecular synthon.

articleTitle: Imaging using feedback interferometry with integrated 260 GHz emitter
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on investigation of a self-mixing effect in integrated voltage-control oscillator (VCO). The VCO is fabricated using bipolar transistors in a 130 nm SiGe BiCMOS technology. It employs a differential Colpitts configuration and is optimized for emission at fundamental harmonic. The radiation is outcoupled through the substrate side using a hyper-hemispheric silicon lens. The source emits up to 0.3 mW of propagating power, tuneable in the frequency range from 258 to 262 GHz. A feedback radiation produces a self-mixing current which can be measured either in dc regime or by employing signal modulation techniques. We show the applicability of self-mixing effect to form reflection-type images.

articleTitle: Probing charge transport in heterostructured phase-segregated hybrid perovskite semiconductors with terahertz radiation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We employ terahertz radiation to investigate the impact of phase segregation on the charge-carrier dynamics and transport properties of mixed halide perovskite films. We reveal negligible impact on charge-carrier mobilities, and preservation of Drude-like transport. We demonstrate enhanced lattice anharmonicity that underlines the ionic migration mechanisms. We show how minimal structural transformations have a dramatic effect on the charge-carrier dynamics as a result of charge funnelling.

articleTitle: Spintronic inverse spin hall photomixing: demonstration of THz CW and frequency comb generation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a novel THz photomixing paradigm exploiting ultrabroadband inverse spin Hall emitters. Both narrow band $(\sim 20$ Hz) CW emission by beating of two stabilized IR DFB lasers on a Pt/CoFeB/W stack is obtained as well as successful spintronic downconversion of a IR frequency comb to a THz comb with 1GHz spacing.

articleTitle: Enhancing the infrared and visible emission properties of calcium silicate hydrate for radiative cooling using metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Two periodic structures composed of metal cylinders with different orientations are used to improve the solar reflection of calcium silicate hydrate (CSH) while maintaining its atmospheric emission. Interesting effects have been found when the distance between bars is small, suggesting that lattice effects, arising from the interaction between the rods could be leveraged in the design of these metamaterials. The size of the metal bars is selected based on state of the art micro-manufacturing techniques. This study limits its scope to a CSH gel model; i.e. the most important component of cement-based materials. Further research will be undertaken to consider a best description of the dielectric function of concrete.

articleTitle: Experimental Verification of -1st Topological Charge in Vortex Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Vortex beams are promising for applications of communications, imaging, chiral detection, and so on. However, they cannot be effective excited with tunability over broadband. In this work, based on a fabricated multi-mode broadband vortex beam antenna, the vorticity of the topological charge from the generated vortex beam is directly validated in the specific observation direction. The experimental results agree well with the simulated ones, which also indicate the radiation and vortex characteristics of the proposed vortex antenna.

articleTitle: THz sources: from semiconductor antennas to relativistic electrons
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: I will discuss some developments related to two types of THz sources: on the one hand photoconductive antennas, including recent results using the material germanium, and on the other hand I will give an overview on the accelerator based coherent infrared and THz sources operating at HZDR, and discuss plans for a successor facility.

articleTitle: High Resolution Molecular Spectroscopy in the THz Region Using Synchrotron Radiation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Our team exploits the synchrotron radiation extracted by the AILES beamline of SOLEIL synchrotron facility to study different molecular physics problematics in the far-IR and THz spectral ranges. The existing experimental configuration of the beamline, with a high-resolution Bruker interferometer, allows the rotationally resolved spectra of a large number of molecules to be obtained. These absorption spectra cover a broad spectral range (typically between 1 and 30 THz, i.e., 30 and 900 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) but are limited in terms of spectral resolution to 30 MHz (0.001 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) by the ultimate optical path difference provided by the interferometer. To push the resolution limit further, we are developing a new spectrometer allowing to record sub-MHz resolution absorption spectra using heterodyne mixing of the synchrotron radiation with a THz molecular laser.

articleTitle: Tracking Ultrafast Photocurrent Generation and Transport in hBN-Encapsulated Graphene Using On-Chip THz Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigate ultrafast photocurrent generation and transport in high-quality graphene photodetector (PD) with its intrinsic time scale using on-chip THz spectroscopy and ZnO gate structure with the minimum capacitive coupling. We successfully readout photothermoelectric current with the 3 dB bandwidth of 220 GHz, which is previously limited to around 70 GHz due to bandwidth limitation of readout electronics and the large RC time constant of the device. As a result, we comprehensively understood how incident light is converted to electrical current in graphene, which is crucial information for developing ultrafast graphene optoelectronics towards the next generation of telecom and datacom.

articleTitle: A THz Vector Modulator Based on Waveguide Insertion Micro-structure
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper proposes a THz vector modulator based on Waveguide Insertion Micro-structure. The device consists of a quadrature 3dB directional coupler, a modulation chip and a combiner. Meanwhile, to minimize the chip area and simplify the chip structure, the directional coupler and combiner both adopt the waveguide structure. The simulation results show that the modulator can achieve $0 \sim 360 ^{\circ}$ phase modulation and amplitude modulation depth greater than 60dB at 220GHz, and the Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (QPSK) modulation function with phase error less than ±3° and insertion loss better than 8dB at 220GHz can be achieved.

articleTitle: THz nanoscopy of platinum thin films
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz nanoscopy is emerging as a powerful technique for the study of the optical and electronic properties of materials at the nanoscale, proving particularly important for mapping heterogeneous surfaces and nano-patterned devices. In this work, we apply terahertz scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (THz-SNOM) to study the thickness-dependent conductivity of platinum thin films, with deeply sub-wavelength spatial resolution. Remarkably, our experimental data shows measurable layer contrast in the near-field scattering signal allowing us to detect differences in thin-film thickness down to the nanometer level. Micro four-point probe (M4PP) analysis of the thin-film sheet conductance confirms the trend observed in the THz-SNOM data that the near-field scattering signal, normalized to the response of the substrate, scales proportionately with film thickness. Our data suggests this technique can be widely used to characterize nanoscale variations in conductivity of metallic thin-films, as well as layered two-dimensional materials and nano-patterned devices.

articleTitle: THz characterization of GeSn monocrystalline thin films
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The employment of other group IV materials, such as alloys of germanium and tin, poses a solution for overcoming the efficiency limit of silicon that arises from its indirect bandgap. By using THz spectroscopy, the optoelectronic properties, such as conductivity, mobility, carrier lifetime, can be extracted non-invasively, since there is no electrical contact. In this work, we use optical pump-THz probe (OPTP) spectroscopy to examine the photoconductivity lifetime and mobility of GeSn alloy thin film samples with different Sn concentration. The results demonstrate photoconductivity lifetimes on nanosecond timescales and carrier mobilities in range of 40~210cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/(Vs), highlighting the promise of these thin films in device applications.

articleTitle: Waveguide-integrated optically-controlled THz modulator
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present an optically-tuned THz modulator working in the 0.75–1.1 THz range with 3-dB insertion losses and 40 MHz bandwidth. Integration in WR1.0 waveguide is investigated and shows up to theoretical 13-dB modulation depth according to numerical simulations.

articleTitle: LiNbO3 Waveguide for Efficient CW THz Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A single pass lithium niobate (LN) waveguide is presented, which simulations suggest can generate monochromatic terahertz (THz) frequency radiation over a broad spectral range at room temperature in continuous wave operation. This waveguide achieves sufficiently high intensity to provide efficient optical-to-THz conversion by making use of thin-film LN and a high confinement. Operation up to 5 THz is expected.

articleTitle: Soft-mode dynamics and sublattice polarization in an archetypal antiferroelectric
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz and far-infrared techniques are combined with complementary Raman and inelastic neutron scattering results to probe the low-energy phonon dynamics of archetypal antiferroelectric candidate - francisite (Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> Bi(SeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> Cl). The combined results characterize the relationship between in-phase (polar) and out-of-phase (antipolar) sublattice dynamics across an antiferroelectric phase transition. Applying a modified Cochran description of these soft-modes allows us to extract an experimental signature that is highly suggestive of the illusive sublattice polarization that is the antiferroelectric order parameter.

articleTitle: Label-Free Detection and Discrimination of SARS-CoV-2 Variants Using Terahertz Metamaterial Sensing Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present the first label-free detection and discrimination of SARS-CoV-2 variants having global spread (Wild-type, delta and omicron) by combining terahertz (THz) time-domain spectroscopy and a metamaterial-based sensing chip. THz spectra suggest sensitive discrimination between variants that have only one or two different amino-acid sequences for each virus type, respectively, within just few minutes.

articleTitle: Stimulated Non-Collinear Intersubband Polariton-Polariton Scattering in a Dispersive Multi-THz Microcavity
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Non-collinear pump-probe spectroscopy with phase-stable multi-THz pulses reveals the ultrafast scattering dynamics of intersubband polaritons in a dispersive microcavity. For resonant excitation of the lower polariton at a finite in-plane momentum, $k_{||}$, a narrowband maximum emerges in the probe reflectivity at the polaritonic ground state at $k_{||}=0$. A quantum mechanical model reproduces the experimental key results quantitatively and confirms the underlying microscopic process as stimulated polariton-polariton scattering. These results are an important milestone on the way to bosonic lasing in custom tailored polaritonic systems in the multi-THz and THz spectral regions.

articleTitle: A 140GHz Terahertz Amplitude Direct Modulator Based on Schottky Diode
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a terahertz amplitude modulator based on the Schottky diode is presented. In the modulator, the diodes embedded in a metal microstrip line are controlled by the bias voltage to change the on-off characteristics, so the terahertz wave can be modulated. The static test results can achieve a rather low insertion loss of 1.87dB, the maximum isolation reaches up to 23dB. A further test shows that the maximum modulation rate can reach 12GHz.

articleTitle: Millimeter wave based compact, weatherproof and mobile water status measurement for crops
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this work, a compact, weatherproof, mobile and cost-effective measuring system was developed based on a 94 GHz gunn oscillator. Through an integrated evaluation and analysis of the measurement signals, the prevailing environmental conditions and the respective plant type, a concrete irrigation recommendation is issued.

articleTitle: Nanoscale Electro-Photonic Tweezer for Terahertz Monitoring of Dynamic Assembly of Nanoparticles under Aqueous Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The probing technique of the evolution of nanoparticle (NP) assembly in an aqueous environment is essential to understanding the phase evolution of the NPs in the nanoscale. Terahertz (THz) sensing with resonant structures has emerged as a high-sensitive sensing platform with unique characteristics including label-free and non-destructive manner. Nevertheless, the high absorption of liquid severely hindered direct underwater detection. Here we suggest the THz monitoring device using vertically aligned double layers of nanoslot-hybridized metamaterial which can capture and detect the NPs simultaneously. Combining the electrical tweezing techniques with spatially overlapped optical hotspots, will give powerful methods of advanced surface-sensitive biosensors.

articleTitle: Multilayer Terahertz Imaging at Kilohertz Pixel Rate
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present our recent results on multilayer terahertz imaging at 1.6 kHz pixel rate employing an ECOPS (electronically controlled optical sampling) based terahertz time-domain spectroscopy system. Using a rotating sample and a translating measurement head, we image individual layer thicknesses on metallic and nonmetallic disks of 300 mm diameter in less than 3 minutes.

articleTitle: Determining the Structures of Condensed Phase Solids with Terahertz Vibrational Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The strong dependence of terahertz vibrational dynamics on weak and long-range forces enables its use as a powerful tool to study polymorphic materials. This has made terahertz vibrational spectroscopy extremely valuable for not only understanding the fundamental origins for the stability of structures, but also for uncovering the correct structure where other methods, such as X-ray diffraction, fail. The complex and large-amplitude motions involved in terahertz phonons additionally provide insight into possible phase transformation phenomena, often uncovering mechanistic information through analysis of the terahertz modes. Overall, this work highlights recent efforts to apply terahertz spectroscopy to structural studies, in both the crystalline and amorphous phases.

articleTitle: Light-matter interaction with a Single Terahertz meta-atom
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this work, by combining an asymmetric Silicon immersion lens configuration and a complementary resonator design, far-field transmission measurement of a single subwavelength split-ring resonator, ultra-strongly coupled to inter Landau level transitions in a single quantum well, is resolved. The highest coupling is 60%, achieved for only ~2000 coupled electrons for a single resonator on an InSb quantum well. This technique can be useful to characterize the complex conductivity of micron-sized samples, such as exfoliated graphene or transition metal dichalcogenide flakes, in the THz domain.

articleTitle: Broadband THz-TDS with 5.6 mW average power at 540 kHz with organic crystal BNA
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate a high dynamic range THz-TDS operating with high average power (5.6 mW) at 540 kHz repetition rate, with a broad bandwidth of 8 THz using the organic crystal BNA. The pump laser is an industrial Yb-laser system, temporally compressed to a pulse duration of sub-50 fs, and a high conversion efficiency of 0.1% is achieved.

articleTitle: High-resolution Terahertz near-field measurements for 2D-material inspection in reflection-mode geometry
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) inspection is a versatile tool for the non-destructive, quantitative characterization of conductive thin-films, including 2D-materials such as graphene. In this work, we apply high-resolution THz near-field transceiver probe-tips for the inspection of graphene-layers in reflection-mode. By taking advantage of the additional interface-selectivity of the reflection-mode not available in transmission-mode, we can now directly discern substrate- from top-layer inhomogeneity, which is important for the reliable 2D-layer characterization on inhomogeneous substrates.

articleTitle: Multi-Extreme THz ESR Study of Triangular Lattice Substance CsCuCl3
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: THz ESR results of triangular lattice antiferro-magnet CsCuCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> under pressure will be presented. CsCuCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> shows the magnetization plateau under pressure, which suggests a pressure induced quantum phenomena. We will show that our analyses with detailed magnetic and THz ESR measurements under pressure suggest a continuous evolution from the semi-classical regime to the highly-quantum regime with increasing pressure.

articleTitle: Observation of Third Harmonic Generation in Two-Dimensional MoS2 Semiconductor Using Terahertz Free-Electron Laser
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This study presents the third harmonic generation (THG) in two-dimensional MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> deposited on Si/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> substrate. Intense terahertz pulses from a free-electron laser were used as pump. The pump central frequency is 3.5 THz, and the THG peak is observed around 10 THz. The THG intensity dependence on excitation density follows the $I_{3 \omega} \propto I_{\omega}^{3}$ relation which further confirms the THG.

articleTitle: A Digitally Backlit-photoexcitation Coding Reflectarray for Terahertz Beam Steering Based on Metal-VO2 hybrid high-impedance surface
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper presents an independently controlled terahertz (THz) coding reflectarray with a digitally backlit-photoexcitation vanadium dioxide (VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) film. With a digitally backlit laser module, the high-impedance-surface (HIS) metasurface can efficiently modulate reflected THz waves without metallic ground. The proposed design can control each unit cell individually without photo-feeding blocks and electrical-feeding parasitics. This work may motivate the development of high-speed wireless communications and high-resolution imaging systems.

articleTitle: A Simple Thickness Profiling of Urethane Foam using Transmissive Characteristics of 700GHz Terahertz Continuous-Wave
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A simple but robust method of estimating thickness of Urethane foam by way of absorbance using continuous wave of 700GHz is presented. Our measurement was found to give 0.08mm in average thickness error with smoothed raw data in small Z-height range, which infers that the depth of focus is attributed to the estimation accuracy. We also found that by increasing the detector integration time, which increases Signal-to-Noise ratio (S/N) of the detector signal, the estimation error is reduced by 75%, which suggests that the accuracy of thickness profiling of Urethane foam can be improved by low noise readout performance.

articleTitle: Mode-locked semiconductor heterostructure lasers integrated with multilayer graphene
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: By integrating, with innovative photonic architectures, in the cavity of miniaturized quantum cascade lasers (QCLs) a multilayers graphene film, we demonstrate passive mode-locking in random THz lasers and self-starting short pulse emission in broadband QCL wire lasers in the 2.3-3.6 THz range.

articleTitle: Coherent interaction between a gate-defined quantum dot and a terahertz split-ring resonator in the ultrastrong coupling regime
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Hybrid excitations of light and matter in the ultrastrong coupling regime have been intensively investigated to explore novel material functions. However, realization of ultrastrong coupling in a-few-electron systems has been challenging because of the small electronic dipole moment. Here, we fabricate a gate-defined quantum dot (QD) in the vicinity of a gap of a terahertz (THz) split-ring resonator (SRR). By illuminating the system with external THz radiation, the QD shows anti-crossing behavior between the electronic states and the resonance mode of the SRR. Our result indicates that, owing to the field enhancement by the SRR, the system enters the ultrastrong coupling regime even when only a few electrons reside in the QD.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation on a 263GHz Continuously Frequency-Tunable Terahertz Gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A 263 GHz continuously frequency-tunable terahertz gyrotron has been investigated experimentally. The operating frequency, frequency-tunable bandwidth and the output power with respect to the operating parameters are presented.

articleTitle: Reflectionless Metasurface With High Refractive Index in the 50-THz Band for Directivity Control of Thermal Radiation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Control of electromagnetic waves emitted from hot objects, thermal radiation, is an attractive technique for advanced thermal control. However, the previously reported thermal radiation control by direct microfabrication to objects is difficult to apply to already-existing systems. Reflectionless metasurfaces with a high refractive index in the infrared region could be applied to structures allowing directivity control of thermal radiation by retrofitting. Here, we demonstrate a reflectionless metasurface with a high refractive index in the 50-THz band, where thermal radiation from a 500 K object has an intensity peak, consisting of square Au patches on both the front and back of an ultrathin SiNx membrane of 100 nm thickness. Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy measurements predict a high refractive index of 9.14 and the reflectance of 19.5% at 48.8 THz. Directivity control of thermal radiation by retrofitting structures based on this metasurface on a hot object would be applicable to existing systems and helpful for thermal management and energy harvesting.

articleTitle: Towards stable coherent undulator radiation based on Steady State Microbunching SSMB
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on correlating THz bursting signatures from longitudinal compressed bunches for emitting coherent synchrotron radiation (CSR) with signals from coherent undulator pulses generated by the mechanism of steady state microbunching (SSMB). There is clear evidence, that the state of the electron bunch in phase-space and the effective emission of coherent undulator radiation can be correlated and thereby optimized.

articleTitle: A priori Information and Off-axis Measurement in Terahertz Tomography
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: By means of ray tracing, we incorporate a priori information about the sample geometry in the reconstruction process of terahertz computed tomography to improve imaging performance. We acquire radiation diverted by the sample instead of considering only transmission data from straight beam paths. The additional data and the beam path simulations are taken into account in an iterative two-step reconstruction process. To test the developed method experimentally, measurements on two representative samples are performed and evaluated.

articleTitle: Measurement of Dielectric-Lined Waveguides for Low-Loss mm-Wave and THz Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Dielectric-lined waveguides are an affordable alternative to corrugated waveguides at mm-wave and THz frequencies. They are easier to fabricate compared to machining mm-sized corrugations, can operate at frequencies where machining sub-wavelength corrugations is no longer practical $(\gt 300$ GHz), and do not suffer from Bragg reflection. Measurements of prototype dielectric-lined waveguides verify that they support the HE11 mode and have very low attenuation.

articleTitle: Semiempirical optimization of frequency-diverse holograms for localization
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a new design technique for frequency-diverse holograms used in millimeter- and submillimeter-wave imaging. A neural-network backed imaging method utilizes quasirandom hologram structure, which disperses the field in the region of interest across the WR-3.4 (220-330 GHz) band. The global optimum for the hologram structure is generally not known. A new, semiempirical optimization method utilizes the experimental data used in localization tasks. The data is a collection of the of the local field at the object plane measured with a probe ($S _{\mathbf{21}}$), and the corresponding localization performance derived from the reflection spectra of a corner cube ($S _{\mathbf{11}}$). The frequency diversity of the local field at the object is correlated with the localization error. The proposed design technique uses the obtained empirical correlation data to inform a new hologram design.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Simulation to Determine Mesoscopic Dielectric Particle Parameters for Optimal Terajet Effect
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper reports on optimization of the parameters, by mean of electromagnetic simulations to obtain the values of the parameters that permit optimal conditions for terahertz (THz) radiation detection using the terajet effect generated by inserting a cuboid-shaped mesoscopic dielectric particle in the optical path at in the front of the rectifier. The obtained results show that the length of edge of the cuboid is the key parameter that conditions the performance of the detection system. A substantial gain is obtained under optimal conditions.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic THz mixer based on iron-doped InGaAs in a plasmonic microcavity
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present an optoelectronic THz mixer based on irondoped InGaAs integrated into a plasmonic microcavity. The measured conversion loss is as low as $\sim 30$ dB at 300 GHz, which constitutes a 30 dB improvement in comparison to state-of-the-art photoconductors without a plasmonic microcavity. In particular for application as receivers in high-data rate wireless telecom the presented design is very promising.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of High-Power K-band Gyro-TWT
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation of a High-Power K-Band Gyro-TWT operating in the fundamental TE 11 mode. The major sections of the tube are designed detailly. The Magnetron injection electron gun (MIG) achieves velocity ratio (a) of 1.3 and velocity spread $\left(\Delta \beta_z\right)$ of 1.9 %.
