articleTitle: Highly Sensitive Room Temperature Heterodyne Detection with Stabilized Qc Lasers
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A heterodyne detection system, made with unipolar devices operating @$4.5 \mu \text{m}$, reaches a record noise equivalent power of 200 fW at room temperature. Key elements of this setup are frequency stabilized QC lasers and high-speed detectors.

articleTitle: Nanoimprinted sheet polarization elements for terahertz vector beams generation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We propose an exotic polarization optical element formed of nanoimprinted wire-grid sheet polarizers to generate a terahertz (THz) cylindrical vector beam, including radially and azimuthally polarized beams in an entire THz frequency range.

articleTitle: Spectral imaging at 5.7 THz
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report a development of a coherent, tunable, 100kW parametric source at $\sim 6$ THz for high-resolution imaging in comparison with a similar source at $\sim 2$ THz. To take advantage of the tunable coherent source, we also report spectrally resolved imaging between 5.55 and 5.87 THz to reveal the spectroscopic characteristics of Aprovel, which is an important medicine for blood pressure control.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Influence of Surface Roughness on Reflective THz Measurements
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: When using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy in reflective configuration, the effect of surface roughness on the reflected signal should be considered to ensure reliable material classification. We investigate the effect of surface roughness by fabricating samples from different materials with defined roughness parameters. These samples are measured in a reflective goniometer setup under varying angles of incidence and reflection. The effect of surface parameters on the THz transient is investigated for a range of materials.

articleTitle: An ultra-high-resolution technique for detection of terahertz pulses
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a novel technique for the detection terahertz pulses generated by femtosecond lasers. It features a Hz-level resolution and does not require a mechanical delay stage or a second femtosecond laser. It works by opto-electronically downconverting the individual frequency components composing the terahertz pulse. Unlike other techniques, it does not require an external spectrum analyzer or a lock-in amplifier for its implementation, although it can also be implemented using them. We believe this technique is a valuable tool to study the ultimate frequency stability of terahertz pulsed systems and the phase noise of the femtosecond lasers that drives them.

articleTitle: Anomalous Effects in the THz Spectra for Quantum Magnet Atacamite
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The polarisation and temperature dependence of the THz spectrum for single-crystalline atacamite has been measured. The non-resonant transmission background was seen to be strongly polarisation dependent. Two absorption bands were resolved in the frequency range up to 400 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> at 226 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and 334 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. Both absorption bands exhibited atypical behaviour, including frequency and linewidth shifting discontinuities between 15 K and 20 K. Additionally, there was a reduction of linewidth upon heating, and deviation from Bose-Einstein statistics in frequency shifting. Further investigation is needed to explain the origins of these anomalies.

articleTitle: Advanced Terahertz Imaging Applications beyond Absorption Cross-Section Limits
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We developed various types of terahertz metasurface-based sensing platforms for highly sensitive imaging of biochemical species with enhanced image contrast. Target biomolecules and variants were captured by sensitively enhanced terahertz signals at the near-field regime. Further studies with an optical parameter extraction algorithm and data processing represented great promise as a future work beyond the absorption cross-section and diffraction limits.

articleTitle: Ultrafast THz emission of spintronic CoFe/Pt thin films
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: THE recent discovery of ultrafast spintronic THz emitters has attracted a lot of attention due to their high power, broadband emission as well as easy fabrication [1, 2]. They are based on nanometer-thin bilayers of a magnetic (M) and a nonmagnetic (NM) metal layer and rely on the inverse spin Hall effect. The THz emission properties can be tuned by using different M or NM materials, tailoring the magnetic properties [3], or building functional layer stacks [4, 5]. Here, we present the THz emission of ultrathin Co<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>/Pt bilayers as a function of the Co concentration x.

articleTitle: Single-shot terahertz waveform stamping on ultrashort electron bunch
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this study, the real-time terahertz oscilloscope by using the relativistic electron stamping technique with a metal slit structure is introduced. We found the unique condition of subwavelength metal slit waveguide for preserving the distortion-free terahertz waveform during its propagation. As a proof-of-concept experiment, we successfully demonstrated to capture the entire filed oscillation of a terahertz pulse with a sampling rate of 75.7 TS/s.

articleTitle: Design of sub-THz unambiguous interferometer for COMPASS-U
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: the concept of the unique sub-mm interferometer for the tokamak COMPASS-U is developed in the Institute of Plasma Physics of Czech Academy of Sciences. The results of the numerical simulations of the beam propagation through the plasma are presented. Due to that the proposed concept is approved as a more suitable solution.

articleTitle: Upgrade plans for the intense THz source and beamline at the soft X-ray free electron laser FLASH
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: As part of the project of upgrading FLASH, the soft X-ray free electron laser (FEL) at DESY in Hamburg, into a seeded FEL, the intense undulator-based THz source will be geometrically separated from the XUV FEL. This allows the THz beamline to operate fully in parallel and largely independent of the XUV FEL, while the beamline transmission will be enhanced for frequencies higher than 6THz. In a newly designed semi-permanent endstation, the XUV beam (approx. 4-60nm), the intense THz beam (1-30THz) and a pump-probe laser (200nm to 1.25$\mu$m) can be combined to study solid state- and surface physics at ultra-short time scales, such as femto-magnetism. The upgrade is planned to be ready for users from 2025.

articleTitle: sSNOM characterization of the IR-active vibrational mode in highly strained hBN
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Hexagonal Boron Nitride is a layered insulator often employed as a protective layer for heterostructures or as host for single photon emitters. In particular, the emission of defects in hBN can be tuned by strain, and it is therefore of the utmost importance to have a reliable method to quantify strain in this system. Here we present a sSNOM experiment on micrometric-sized bubbles of hBN with the aim of addressing the response to strain of the transverse optical IR-active mode.

articleTitle: Terahertz Demethylation of Cancer Cells for Potential Cancer Treatment
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Carcinogenesis involves DNA methylation which is a primary alteration in DNA in the development of cancer before genetic mutation. Because the abnormal DNA methylation is found in most cancer cells, the assessment of DNA methylation using terahertz radiation can be a novel optical method to detect and control cancer. The methylation has been directly observed by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy and this epigenetic chemical change could be manipulated to the state of demethylation using resonant terahertz radiation. Demethylation of cancer cells is a key issue in epigenetic cancer therapy and our results may lead to the treatment of cancer using electromagnetic waves.

articleTitle: A 4.7-THz fundamental Schottky diode mixer
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Fundamental mixers operating at ambient temperatures are essential for realising long-lifetime space missions aiming to measure gas spectra at terahertz frequencies. This paper presents the design and sensitivity analysis of a 4.7-THz fundamental mixer. At supra-THz frequencies, fabrication and assembly tolerances substantially affect the mixer performance, and it is essential to identify critical circuit parameters. This work presents the progress towards a room-temperature heterodyne supra-terahertz receiver.

articleTitle: Near-field diffraction from quasi-periodic structures in the THz regime
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Near-field diffraction from periodic structures leads to self-imaging (the Talbot effect), while dedicated quasi-periodic structures are used to generate orbital angular momentum in THz beams. However, the image stack taken in regular steps of increasing distance behind the grating suffers from experimental effects such as inhomogeneous laser power, parasitic interferences, or misalignment. We circumvent these flaws by evaluating the image stacks in the Fourier domain to identify the Talbot distance. We show how a Fourier transform also allows the identification of the topological charge. We report results on linear, ring and fork gratings.

articleTitle: Soft Ferrite Bi-layer Design of Frequency Selective Micro Cavity
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The designs for Frequency Selective Micro Cavity (FSMC) structures in the terahertz band have been proposed, based on ferrite composite layers. A high-value complex-permittivity Ni<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</inf>Co<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</inf>Zn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.3</inf>Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> base layer has been previously reported and demonstrates low transmittance at 1THz and above. The scope entails design of Anti-Reflective Coatings (ARC) for broad-band $(0.5-2.5\mathrm{THz})$ cavity absorbance of 90% and higher. The reported deliverables are as follows - (i) development of thick film coatings with tunable refractive index based on SU8 and micro-machined ferrite grains, (ii) analytical studies to determine ARC properties (single and bi-layer) for optimal performance, and (iii) multi-physics simulations. The results reported from (ii) and (iii) are well matched. Ongoing work involves setup development for THz reflectance measurements to help validate cavity performance and explore cavity applications.

articleTitle: Plasmonic Hybrid Nanoelectrodes Structure based on Graphene and Silver Nanowire for CW-THz photomixer devices
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) photomixer devices are becoming attractive components for coherent optoelectronic THz systems due to their ability to operate as THz emitters and receivers. Enhanced THz photomixer emitters based on graphene flakes and silver nanowires nanoelectrodes overcome the performance of classical interdigitated photomixers with metal electrodes. Here, we performed a simulation of the hybrid nanoelectrodes structure based on an array of graphene flakes and silver nanowires (AgNWs) to comprehend the plasmonic motion of the generated carriers in the active area of the device. The simulation results show that the conductivity of Ag-NWs was improved by the conductivity of graphene flakes. Where the graphene flakes create a spatial electric field close to their edges. Due to the confined electric field, the carriers will be transported between graphene flakes and Ag-NWs by a spatial plasmonic field, and subsequently making the graphene flakes act as connected rather than isolated. Therefore, graphene and Ag-NWs allow simultaneous carrier transport in the hybrid nanostructure.

articleTitle: Observing and Suppressing an RF Noise Excited by a Parasitic Oscillation in a Collector of 170GHz-gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An rf noise of about 570 MHz was detected with a pick-up coil in an operation of 170GHz-gyrotron. Experiments and calculations indicated that a parasitic oscillation in the collector excited the rf noise at a resonance of TE$_{1,1,2}$ mode. The rf noise was successfully suppressed by increasing the retarding voltage or attaching a thin iron plate which asymmetrically covered the bottom of collector.

articleTitle: Thermal Measurements in Harsh Environments with Mm-wave and THz Radiometry
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Temperature measurements in environments that preclude the use of conventional methods are possible with remote sensing of thermal emission in the mm-wave to THz range of frequencies. A 300-GHz radiometer is demonstrated to be an effective linear temperature sensor. Measurements with a THz blackbody source corroborate the nominal emissivity value of the target to be close to unity. The temperature inferred from radiometry measurements of a target with unknown emissivity is consistent with the physical temperature of the target. Field testing of the radiometer at a nuclear fusion facility for reactor-wall measurements is planned.

articleTitle: Terahertz Metamaterial Sensor in a High-Q Photonic Crystal Cavity
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigate whether metamaterial (MM) embedded in a one-dimensional high-Q photonic crystal (PC) cavity has the potential to be a better terahertz (THz) sensor than a MM (or a PC cavity) alone, when the MM strongly couples with the cavity photons. The resonant frequency shift induced by an analyte on the MM in the cavity is smaller than that obtained with the MM alone. This is attributed to the larger mode volume according to the dielectric perturbation theory. However, the phase sensitivity of the MM is larger than that of the MM alone, which opens a new route for the realization of improved THz phase-sensitive sensors.

articleTitle: Unusual set of anomalies in the lattice dynamics of lawsonite near its phase transitions
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Lawsonite is a water-containing mineral occurring in the Earth’s crust and mantle, exhibiting low-temperature ferroelectricity linked to water molecules. Using broad-band polarized electromagnetic spectroscopy, we studied the lattice dynamics of a single crystal between 1Hz and 20THz at temperatures from 20 to 500K. We identified three anomalies associated with the two phase transitions occurring at 270 and 124K—a critical GHz relaxation, a soft THz phonon, and an overdamped sub-THz excitation in the $\mathbf{E} \|a, \mathbf{E} \|b$ and $\mathbf{E} \|c$ permittivity spectra, respectively. The fact that the soft mode is polarized perpendicularly to the ferroelectric axis is very unusual.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Photoexcitations in Ti3C2Tz, Mo2Ti2C3Tz, and Nb2CTz 2D MXenes
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: MXenes are intrinsically metallic 2D materials. We apply optical pump-THz probe and optical pump-optical probe spectroscopy to unravel the relationships between MXene chemistry, structure, and nature and dynamics of photoexcitations in three MXenes with different chemistries, Ti<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</inf>, Mo<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Ti<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, and Nb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>CT<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</inf>.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Use of THz-Sensing Techniques in the Analysis of Support Structures in Additive Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We evaluate the use and limitations of THz-sensing techniques in additive manufacturing processes, focusing on the aspect of quality control of support structures like infills, inlays and fiber reinforcements.

articleTitle: Analysis of sodium copper chlorophyllin and sodium magnesium chlorophyllin by time-domain THz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The terahertz absorption spectra of sodium magnesium chlorophyllin (Chl-Mg-Na) and sodium copper chlorophyllin (Cu-Chl), two major members of the chlorophyll derivative family, have been measured in the range 0.2-2.5 THz, at room temperature. The capability of terahertz spectroscopy for quantitative characterization of Chl-Mg-Na intermolecular vibrations was investigated and the sensitivity of transitions with degree of hydration by changes in the molecular environment was examined. For the Cu-Chl derivative, a broad feature was observed around 1.8 THz which currently hinders clear Cu-Chl identification and quantification.

articleTitle: Electron mobility in strained nanowires probed by THz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We utilize optical pump – THz probe spectroscopy to estimate electron mobility in strained GaAs/(In,Al)As core/shell nanowires. Our results demonstrate that strain-induced reduction of the effective electron mass leads to a remarkable increase of the mobility. The data analysis indicates an important role of the inhomogeneous plasmon broadening that may affect THz spectra of dense ensembles of nanowires.

articleTitle: Generation of Ultra-broadband THz Pulses at a 200 kHz Repetition Rate with Peak Electric Field Above 100 kV/cm
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate a table-top source delivering ultra-broadband THz pulses with electric field strength exceeding 100 kV/cm at a repetition rate of 200 kHz. The source is based on optical rectification of 23 fs pulses at 1030 nm. We generate THz pulses extending to 11 THz with field amplitude of 150 kV/cm using a GaP crystal and extending up to 30 THz with field amplitude of 104 kV/cm using a GaSe crystal. Our THz source opens a route towards nonlinear time-resolved THz experiments with high signal-to-noise ratios.

articleTitle: Terahertz time resolved spectroscopy of monolayer graphene
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Graphene, a flat monolayer is fabricated by chemical vapour deposition (CVD) and transferred in the form of ultrathin graphitic film on Si (100)/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> substrates and; characterized in transmission mode using terahertz-time domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) at room temperature. The results shows that the four different frequency band are possible in our developed graphene including 0.12, 0.55, 0.83 and 1.35 THz i.e., the peaks correspond to the higher resonance of carbon atoms in graphene due to maximum light matter interaction which shows that it is suitable for development of tunable THz detection devices.

articleTitle: Ultra narrowband detection scheme for dark photon / axion around 30 GHz
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrated that ultra narrowband filtering at 30 GHz dramatically enhances the signal-to-noise ratio to search for dark matter candidates which couple to millimeter waves. A coherent signal relatively locked between a synthesizer and a signal analyzer can be clearly distinguished from incoherent blackbody radiation after real time FFT over a long period. We propose a novel experiment for studying dark matter candidates.

articleTitle: A Broadband Resonant Half-Waveplate for Compact Far-Infrared Grating Spectrometers with Continuous Wavelength Band Division
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Future astronomical space missions in the far-infrared will utilize compact and wideband grating spectrometers. These grating spectrometers are inherently sensitive to a single polarization, enabling an efficient bandsplitting scheme, without spectral gaps, providing a large continuous wavelength coverage. The key component required is a broadband half-waveplate. In this paper we present our results of a broadband resonant halfwave plate, which satisfies the needs for such spectometers.

articleTitle: Unravelling coherent acoustic phonons in rare-earth nickelate thin films by time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this study, we have performed time-resolved terahertz (THz) spectroscopic (TRTS) measurements on rare-earth nickelates thin films of different electronic states. While insulating film EUNiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> (ENO) shows insulator-metal phase transition on increasing the optical pump fluence, metallic film La<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.25</inf>Eu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.75</inf>NiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> (L25ENO) shows contrasting behavior with superposition of acoustic phonon modulations to transient THz transmission. In the case of the insulating ENO film, two relaxation time constants were ascribed as electron-phonon thermalization and the recovery of charge ordering, while for the metallic films, only one relaxation time constant was obtained. Based on these contrasting features, insulating and metallic films can be contemplated as an ultrafast optical switch and ultrafast photo-acoustic devices, respectively.

articleTitle: Tracing the Journey of Molecules in Space with IRMMW-THz Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The space between the stars is not empty but filled with a very dilute gas. In spite of the extremely low temperatures and densities, these clouds contain a surprisingly rich and interesting chemistry, as evidenced by the detection of more than 240 different molecules, from simple to complex. Most of these molecules have been detected with GHz-THz spectroscopy. These clouds are also the birthplaces of new stars and planets. New facilities such as the Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) and the James Webb Space Telescope (Webb) allow us to zoom in on dense cloud cores and planetary system construction sites with unprecedented sharpness and sensitivity. ALMA spectral scans of young disks contain tens of thousands of rotational lines, revealing water and a surprisingly rich variety of organic materials, including simple sugars and high abundances of deuterated species. IR spectroscopy with Webb provides complementary information on solids, ices and Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons. How are these molecules formed and what molecular processes play a role? How common are they? Can they be delivered to new planets and form the basis for life elsewhere in the Universe?

articleTitle: Full field terahertz imaging of high-speed dynamics
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We use terahertz to optical conversion in an atomic vapor to achieve very high-speed imaging in the terahertz frequency range. This technique allows us to capture video at kilohertz frame rates. Using this technique, we demonstrate high-speed imaging of the dynamics of a small explosive detonation contained within an optically opaque container. This proof of principle measurement demonstrates the utility of this method for the monitoring of high-speed effects which are beyond the capabilities of other terahertz imaging techniques.

articleTitle: Comparison of Receiver Performance Between Bow-Tie and Leaky- Wave Based Photoconductive Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Photoconductive antennas (PCA) can be used for future mm-resolution imaging applications. For such scenarios, the model of the propagation link between a transmitter and a receiver is useful for system optimization. However, the performance of such a link is not usually modelled for photoconductive antennas. In this work, we introduce a Norton circuit to model the receiving PCA. With this model, we then compare the performance of two types of antennas: bow-tie and leaky-wave based PCAs. The available and received power of both antennas are quantified and compared. The simulated results show that the leaky-wave antenna performs better than the bow-tie antenna.

articleTitle: Study of resonant Evanescent Orders in All Dielectric metagrating in Terahertz domain
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The gratings operating at subwavelength region can excite and modulate the non-propagating resonant evanescent orders. Here, we demonstrate the excitation of evanescent orders in THz regime employing all dielectric subwavelength grating in reflection mode of operating. Distance dependent exponential decay confirms evanescent nature of the excited modes.

articleTitle: Active Polarization Modulation of Terahertz Radiation Using Metamaterial/Graphene-Based Optoelectronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigate the modulation performance of a metamaterial/graphene optoelectronic device in the THz range. Operating characteristics such as amplitude, phase and polarization modulations of broadband THz radiation are reported. The accomplishments of modulation depth include >75% in spectral amplitude, $\gt 15^{\circ}$ in spectral phase, $\gt 0.2$ active modulation of ellipticity ratio, and active rotational angle changes of 20°. These achievements are the key elements towards efficient manipulations of THz radiation for applications such as next-generation wireless communications, spectroscopy, and imaging.

articleTitle: Scalable THz-OAM Beam Generator Based on Photonic Crystal Structure with Square and Hexagonal Lattices
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: For orbital angular momentum (OAM) beam generation, high-accuracy beam alignment and scalability of topological charges are required. A photonic crystal (PhC)-based OAM generator is proposed and analyzed numerically Very small alignment-dependence can be achieved with high efficiency. We study the scalability of OAM modes, using photonic crystal structures with square and hexagonal lattices.

articleTitle: Theoretical Investigation on a 1-THz Third Harmonic Gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a 1-THz TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15,9</inf> mode third harmonic gyrotron is numerically designed by the self-consistent non-linear theory. The effects of electron beam voltage, beam current, pitch angle and magnetic field of the efficiency are also analyzed in detail. The relationship between the efficiency of velocity spread and beam thickness are calculated as a comparison. Meanwhile, by using the time-dependent multi-mode nonlinear theory, the mode competitions of the gyrotron are investigated.

articleTitle: Introduction of Three-Stage Cavity Resonator in a Multi-Frequency Sub-THz Gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A multi-frequency gyrotron which has a multi-stage cavity resonator has been studied. So far, super multi-frequency oscillation was realized with a resonator consisting of two cavities with different diameters. Each cavity has a series of oscillation modes, which can be selected by the cyclotron frequency of the injected helical electron beam. In the present study, a three-stagere-sonator is introduced to increase the number of operating frequencies. The oscillation experiments have shown that three-stage resonator can be operated at more frequencies than the two-stage resonator.

articleTitle: Intrinsic losses in microwave dielectrics investigated by THz-TDS: A comparison between conventional and spark plasma sintered Zr0.8Sn0.2TiO4 ceramics
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Zr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</inf>TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> powders synthesized by solid state reaction route have been consolidated by conventional and spark plasma sintering methods. Single-phase ceramics with various microstructures and, consequently, different extrinsic absorption were investigated by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy. The results showed that the terahertz spectroscopy can be used for tailoring in the “synthesis – microstructure – properties” cycle.

articleTitle: Waveguide-integrated photoconductive THz receivers
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present the first waveguide-integrated photoconductive antennas (PCA) for continuous-wave (cw) terahertz (THz) detection. The PCAs consisting of an InGaAs photoconductor mesa and a bow-tie antenna are equipped with an on-chip edge-coupled passive optical waveguide. Compared to state-of-the-art top-illuminated PCAs, the novel receivers show an improved frequency up to 2 THz and a total bandwidth of 4 THz. Moreover, these newly developed THz receivers open the door towards compact and low-cost fully integrated photonic THz systems that can be implemented in various industrial applications such as spectroscopy and communications.

articleTitle: Dissipative Kerr solitons in semiconductor ring lasers
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report on experimental and theoretical results showing mid-infrared dissipative Kerr solitons in ring quantum cascade lasers. Two independent measurement techniques shed light on the waveform and coherence of the solitons and confirm a temporal width of $\sim 3$ ps. Background-free 3.7 ps soliton pulses could be demonstrated by optical filtering. Our simulations, being both specific to the studied device and generally valid for any semiconductor ring laser, confirm the existence of such solitons and give insight into the amplitude-modulation dependence on laser parameters.

articleTitle: 2-5 THz Receivers for Thermospheric Science
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Considerable progress has recently been demonstrated for room temperature Schottky based receivers to 1200 GHz. However, pushing operating frequencies to above 2 THz is still considerably challenging due to parasitics associated with traditional planar Schottky diodes. Accurate determination of wind velocities in the thermospheric regime requires receivers at 2.06 and 4.75 THz corresponding to the ionized oxygen (OI) line. This work will provide details on how these receivers are being designed and built to enable measurement of the 3-D winds with high precision.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Terahertz Spectroscopy of Coupling Between Fundamental Excitations in Solids
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Using two-dimensional terahertz spectroscopy, we investigate fundamental electronic, lattice, and spin excitations in solids, and the couplings between them.

articleTitle: Terahertz Chemical Microscope for Calcium Ions and Stress Biomarker Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz biosensing has gained enormous attention in medical diagnosis. In this study, we demonstrated that our developed terahertz chemical microscope (TCM) could be used for sensing of small molecules such as calcium ion, stress biomarker cortisol with extremely consumption of sample solutions and high sensitivity. Calcium ion sensitive membrane and DNA aptamer were utilized for calcium ions and cortisol sensing, respectively. The approach is unique and shows great promising for creating better future healthcare.

articleTitle: Broadband THz Interconnect for Hybrid Integration of InP and Si Platforms
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate a broadband terahertz coupling between InP-based coplanar waveguide and silicon dielectric rod waveguide for hybrid integration. A coupling efficiency of around −2 dB has been experimentally achieved in frequency range between 70-120 GHz. Numerical simulations reveal an operational 3dB-bandwidth $\gt100$ GHz.

articleTitle: Frequency resolved Solvation Dynamics revealed by Optical-pump THz-probe Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Optical-pump THz-probe spectroscopy is employed to measure dynamics of reactions in liquid water. Here we report on recent improvements on the setup towards high sensitivity over a broad THz range from 0.1 to 8 THz and recent results of the THz response of the photoacid HPTS in water after optical excitation.

articleTitle: Tunable Optical Topological Transition of Cherenkov Radiation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Cherenkov radiation is perhaps one of the most famous radiations based on free-electrons. Optical topological transition usually appears in specific metamaterials which possess topological optical properties. In this work, by using the ultrafast photothermal properties of graphene, we indicate the potential of graphene-based hyperbolic metamaterials can be used as a suitable platform for ultrafast tunable Cherenkov radiation sources. On the other hand, the nonlocality of graphene will bring a lower bound of electron velocity for the Cherenkov radiation. It means that the Cherenkov radiation in graphene hyperbolic metamaterials can only be induced by a close range of electron velocity.

articleTitle: Terahertz wave Parametric Generation based on Frequency Controlled 1.5 μm beams using a Spectral Drill Cavity
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrated terahertz wave parametric generation based on frequency controlled 1.5 $\mu$m beams in a nonlinear MgO:LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> crystal. The pumping beam is generated using a PPLN-OPG seeded by a stabilized laser beam as traceable to the national standard. The generated pulses are amplified by a KTA-OPA pumped by a SLM Nd:YAG MOPA system. The seeding beam is monitored and controlled by a “spectral drill” cavity. The frequency of seeding beam is observed as intensity of error signal. We expect that these methods will open up new fields.

articleTitle: THz Aperture Near-Field Spectroscopy of Dirac Plasmons in Topological Insulator Bi2Se3
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We map the dispersion relation in ribbon gratings of topological insulator Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> using both far-field and aperture-type near-field THz spectroscopy methods. The results are consistent with theoretical predictions of coupling between the optical phonon and massless Dirac plasmons.

articleTitle: Landau-Level Signatures in Ultrafast Anomalous Hall Currents at Room Temperature
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We study ultrafast anomalous Hall currents in bulk GaAs generated using optical femtosecond excitation and magnetic fields up to 7 T. The currents’ dynamics are resolved by measuring the simultaneously emitted THz radiation. The resulting current amplitude shows maxima at excitation photon energies, which agree well with interband transitions between valence and conduction band Landau levels. This behavior is observed for both cryogenic and room temperature. While our work helps to better understand the anomalous Hall effect, it also demonstrates a method to detect and possibly employ Landau levels at elevated temperatures.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Mutual Coupling in Integrated Lens Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Future applications in sensing and communications at (sub)-millimetre wavelengths will benefit from having large integrated coherent arrays. The use of lens arrays will enable the fabrication of integrated antenna front-ends with many potential independent beams as well as dynamic scanning capabilities. For applications such as MIMO communications, interferometric arrays and Tx/Rx duplexing capabilities, a key design parameter can be the mutual coupling between the integrated antenna front-ends. In this contribution we model such mutual coupling for lens antenna arrays using Geometrical Optics technique combined with a bidirectional forward ray-tracing. The validation of the methodology against full wave simulations is also presented here.

articleTitle: Effects of hydrogen dissociation in semi-insulating gallium nitride under UV irradiation on terahertz emission properties
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report the terahertz (THz) emission spectroscopy (TES) and photoluminescence (PL) spectroscopy results for a semi-insulating (SI) GaN film in comparison with those for unintentionally-doped (UID) and magnesium (Mg)-doped ones. The THz emission polarity showed their band bending near the surface. In addition, the TES and PL results showed intensity changings over time for SI, UID-GaN, but not for Mg-doped GaN. The origin of these effects was studied by observing the THz emission property in the air and vacuum and attributed to the UV- induced hydrogen dissociation.

articleTitle: A multiline InP-TRL kit for sub-mmWave characterization of InP-HEMT
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigate the development of on-wafer multiline Thru-Reflect-Line calibration kits to enable transistor characterization beyond 110 GHz. The final objective is to measure the S parameters of a HEMT having a very high cut-off frequency (up to THz range). A first kit design shows that the use of configurations suitable for the frequency bands used in the calibration will optimize the measurements of THz transistors.

articleTitle: Understanding the THz spectrum of L-cysteine
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this article we look at understanding the THz spectra of L-cysteine. L-cysteine exhibits a high degree of polymorphism with Form I being the most stable. This polymorph however shows disorder above 30 K via rotation around the C-C-S-H torsion angle. We aim to understand how this disorder influences the THz spectrum using a combination of static DFT phonon calculation of a number of different supercells along with molecular dynamics simulations of appropriate structures.

articleTitle: Infrared Emission from Photoexcited MAPbBr3 Perovskite Film
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Hybrid perovskites have been intensely studied in the last 20 years of research for their extraordinary charge transport properties and peculiar thermalization dynamics. In this study, we show a reflectivity-based, mid-IR analysis of IRAV modes on a photoexcited MAPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> film sample. Reflectance peaks that arise after above-bandgap photoexcitation are explained as radiative infrared emission from the vibrational polaronic states.

articleTitle: Complex Terahertz Conductivity of Sputter-Deposited TiO2 Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A 150 nm TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> film is studied with THz-Time Domain Spectroscopy (THz-TDS) from where we determine the complex sheet conductance and find that it takes the shape of a Lorentz-resonance. Comparing data to the Drude-Smith model of conductivity and the Surface Plasmon model yields the best resemblance to the latter, which suggests that the resonance is caused by surface plasmons.

articleTitle: Sample Thickness Measurements Using Phase-Sensitive Terahertz Upconversion Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate our work on phase-sensitive nonlinear upconversion detection of terahertz radiation, using an off-the-shelf sCMOS sensor. The terahertz radiation is upconverted to infrared light using a nonlinear medium and interferes with a second source of coherent light, which yields the phase relation between both sources. Using this approach, six individual single-layer samples were measured in transmission and compared to terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (TDS) measurement results.

articleTitle: Volumetric Metaoptics for Compact and Low-Power Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Spectroscopy is a critical technology for remote sensing, but realizing compact low-power spectrometers remains challenging. Moreover, there is an obvious need of low-power, low-mass, and low-volume medium spectral resolution spectrometers for a variety of space-based instruments. This work combines a high-Q Fabry-Perot resonator with an inverse-designed, volumetric metaoptics device made of stacked Si layers to form a highly compact, low-power, and broadband spectrometer. The resonator consists of two distributed Bragg reflectors made of cascaded Silicon membranes, each curved by an SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> thin film to support small mode volume resonances. The metaoptics separate the various resonances (spectrally separated by the free-spectral range of the cavity) to their own direct detector.

articleTitle: Ultra-high sensitivity sensor for refractive index sensing application
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We proposed and demonstrated an ultra-high sensitive refractive index sensor for the terahertz band. The sensor consists of a gallium arsenide (GaAs) structure on top, aluminum in the middle, and a polyimide substrate. The simulation results show that the sensor has an absorption peak at 2.0 THz with the Q-factor up to 444. The sensor is very sensitive to the change of the refractive index (RI) of the surrounding medium. The optimized structure has a sensitivity of 1.762 THz/RIU and a Figure of merit (FoM) value of 392 RIU<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. The proposed metamaterial sensor with such high sensitivity has broad application prospects in biomedical sensing, and trace substance detection.

articleTitle: Design of a multi-channel POlarimeter-INTerferometer system based on terahertz solid-state diode sources on EAST
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Plasma position plays a critical role in fusion plasma performance, and any loss of the plasma position control is not acceptable for safe fusion device operations. To maintain a high temperature plasma, the plasma should not touch the wall of the vacuum chamber and be confined in the magnetic field. So studying fast and accurate plasma position measurement technique is very necessary. Traditional measurement methods are affected by discharge duration, high temperature and electromagnetic interference. The plasma position can also be measured by Faraday-effect polarimeter as a non-inductive position sensor with fast time response. In this work, a multi-channel Vertical POlarimeter-INTerferometer (V-POINT) based on 0.65 Thz solid-state diode sources (SSDS) for horizontal plasma position measurements on the EAST tokamak has been designed. The optical design and bench test results of the V-POINT on EAST will be presented.

articleTitle: Impact of the Addition of Tin on the Charge Carrier Dynamics of Metal Halide Perovskites
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The gradual partial to full introduction of lead into pure tin films has been shown to enhance the stability and performance of tin-based perovskite thin films. However, how its influences the charge carrier recombination dynamics is yet to be studied. Here, the impact of the addition of tin on the charge carrier recombination dynamics is studied. We elucidate an enhancement in the charge carrier lifetime and hence reduction in monomolecular recombination with the introduction of higher lead ratio.

articleTitle: A Wideband 220GHz Sub-harmonic Mixer Based on Multistage Reduction Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, we designed a 220G subharmonic mixer based on planar Schottky diodes. The feeding effect of the RF signal has a great influence on the conversion loss of the mixer. We introduce a multi-stage reduced height structure at the RF input to widen the mixer bandwidth. Based on measurement results, an RF frequency range 200-240GHz, a Single Sideband(SSB) conversion loss of 9dB±1dB operation at IF frequency 1GHz. This wideband sub-harmonic mixer operates at room temperature, which can be used in communication systems.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Measurement of Relativistic Electron Bunch Using Electro-Optic Sampling
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Single-shot measurement of radiations such as electron beams, ion beams, neutrons, and X-rays, helps diagnose the quality of beams and improve practical applications. This paper presents a single-shot measurement of relativistic electron bunch using electro-optic (EO) sampling. To realize single-shot measurement, the spatio-temporal distribution of a femtosecond laser was manipulated by an optical element of an echelon mirror or a grating. Polarization change of the laser is induced by THz electric field near relativistic electron bunch due to Pockels effect. Finally, the polarization components of the laser will be analyzed using a detector to measure the electric field.

articleTitle: Terahertz birefringence and dichroism in Fe Doped β-Ga2O3
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: To the best of our knowledge, we report the first experimental study, which shows Terahertz (THz) birefringence and dichroism in the range of 0.2 THz to 2.5 THz in Fe doped $\beta-Ga_{2}O_{3}$ and compares its THz spectral transmission with the undoped $Ga_{2}O_{3}$.

articleTitle: The influence of self-heating phenomenon on the current-voltage curve of the Silicon-based Blocked-Impurity-Band Terahertz detectors
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We fabricate Silicon-based blocked impurity band (BIB) terahertz detector using phosphorus-dopant. The response waveform distortion of the device can be observed at high bias or temperature. Through the forward and reverse scanning of IV curve, we verify that the thermal relaxation phenomenon is caused by the self-heating effect of the device, which results in a current increment of one order of magnitude. This work highlights the importance of the thermal effect and their influence on the performance of the detectors.

articleTitle: THz Channel Sounder and VNA Verification Measurement Based Over-the-Air Multipath Artifact
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An over-the-air propagation of a quasi-static channel made by a correlation-based channel sounder compared to the same channel using a vector network analyzer at WR3.4 THz band is presented. The measurements produced fixed and comparable multipath components with calculable propagational properties to test measurement resolution and path loss at THz band. The power delay profile was selected as a measurement metric at both types of equipment for different rotational steps. The measurements showed a good performance of the sounder compared to the VNA in terms of measured distance and path loss.

articleTitle: Study of the Radiation Field From a Hollow Electron Beam Inside an Infrared Free Electron Laser Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: At University of Science and Technology of China, we have an Infrared (IR) free electron laser (FEL) oscillator experimental facility (FELiChEM) to generate radiations in the wavelength range of 2.5-50 m and 40-200 m. The output power is one of the most concerned parameters by the users. Since the electron beam distribution and the out-coupling hole in the resonator mirror can influence the saturated power and the optical mode, it would be an important issue to the output power of the IR light source. It has been demonstrated that use of a hollow electron beam could offer a higher saturated power than use of a Gaussian electron beam. Thus we consider the operation of FELiChEM with a hollow beam, and analyze its effect on FEL performance.

articleTitle: Terahertz Imaging and Spectroscopic Measurements in the Presence of Scattering for Biophotonics Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate THz spectroscopic transmission and reflection imaging through turbid media. We show that the reconstruction of the sample’s extinction spectrum is possible using multiresolution analysis based on wavelet transforms. We discuss various biophotonics applications and outlook toward polarimetric measurements in the presence of scattering.

articleTitle: Advanced Data Processing For Tomography and 3D Rendering With Terahertz Waves
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Terahertz technology (between 0.1 and 4 THz) is now a well-established tool to achieve contact-free and non-destructive testing (NDT). Among the technologies, THz CT and phase retrieval are emerging techniques which have been investigated during the last decade. Thus, in this presentation, we focus on the analyze capabilities from 3D reconstructed volumes of a complex object obtained by a real time-THz imaging system. We demonstrate that images obtained are compatible with an automated processing composed of: i) an ad-hoc segmentation, extracting the sample from the background and reconstruction noise ii) a component labelling, iii) a skeletonization, providing additional meta-data about the sample morphology. We also present how we can assess to phase information of the object by phase retrieval from intensity measured in a volumetric grid.

articleTitle: Bias-free Photoconductive Terahertz Generation through a Bilayer InAs Structure Grown on a Silicon Substrate
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a bias-free plasmonic photoconductive terahertz emitter that utilizes the built-in electric field induced in a bilayer InAs structure grown on a high-resistivity silicon substrate. Significant enhancement in the radiated power beyond 0.5 THz is observed as compared to the same structure grown on GaAs. The enhancement originates from higher terahertz transmission through the silicon substrate and a shorter carrier lifetime for the InAs layers grown on silicon due to a larger lattice mismatch.

articleTitle: Low-frequency Vibrational Characteristic of Carbamazepine Co-crystal with Nicotinamide Base on THz and Low-wavenumber Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The low-frequency vibrational properties for carbamazepine co-crystal with nicotinamide (CBZ-NIC) have been characterized by combining the THz spectroscopy with low-wavenumber Raman spectroscopy. The experimental and theoretical results show CBZ-NIC co-crystal not only have different characteristic absorption peaks in 0.3-2.5 THz region, but also have significant low-wavenumber Raman characteristic peaks in $0-100 \mathrm{cm}^{-1}$. And the simulation shows a better agreement with the measured vibrational peaks position. Meanwhile, the low-frequency infrared and/or Raman active of characteristic peaks for such co-crystals were discussed. The results indicate this method can provide more comprehensive low-frequency vibrational information, which could play an important role in pharmaceutical science.

articleTitle: Using THz-TDS for assessing the effects of transdermal drug delivery methods on skin
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this work, we use THz spectroscopic measurements in a reflection set-up to evaluate the response of the skin to the application of woven and PET film backed patches, showing the dynamics of the hydration levels of the areas covered by both patches. The results demonstrate that areas covered by the PET film patches were strongly affected for longer than 4hrs whilst the application of the woven patches allowed for the skin to recover to its original hydration within 30 minutes of patch removal.

articleTitle: Dissipative Parametric Gain and Multiphoton Effects in Quantum GaAs/AlGaAs Superlattice
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A cavityless dissipative parametric gain in quantum GaAs/AlGaAs superlattice is demonstrated and discussed. Using a waveguide-based setup under the biasing of dc and microwave pump, emission lines, corresponding to the simultaneous multiphoton processes in the superlattice, were observed. It was shown that the incident electromagnetic wave experiences transformation into a slow longitudinal electrostatic wave inside the superlattice, ensuring hence the gain levels exceeding 1000 cm$^{-1}$.

articleTitle: 3D Printed THz Diffraction Gratings and Applications in THz Research
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigated two types of 3D printed terahertz (THz) transmission diffraction gratings: binary phase grating and blazed grating. The diffraction efficiency as a function of diffraction angle was mathematically derived and simulated, and the printed THz gratings were tested using an FTIR system. Our study suggests that the 3D printed THz grating has the potential of being used as a dispersive optical element to characterize THz sources.

articleTitle: Fabrication and Characterization of High-Q Longwave Infrared Ge Microresonator at 8 μm
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Achieving low-loss optical microresonators at longwave infrared (LWIR) frequencies could portend new developments in integrated nonlinear optics and sensing on a chip. We report on the realization of a germanium (Ge) whispering gallery mode microresonator from a non-epitaxial fabrication process using high-quality Ge material. By coupling the output of a QCL at 7.8 um into a partially suspended Ge-on-glass waveguide, an intrinsic quality factor (Q) of 2.5 ×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> is reported. [1] Compared with previous studies, our work shows the importance and great promise of maintaining high-quality materials for integrated photonics at LWIR.

articleTitle: Jamming at Terahertz Frequencies: Security Vulnerabilities of Wireless Links
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We study previously unidentified aspects of jamming threats of terahertz wireless links. We show that a single-tone jamming can have significant impact on an incoherent wireless link even if detuned from the link’s frequency. Our findings reveal important vulnerabilities which may redefine aspects of the physical layer security in the THz range.

articleTitle: 3-D printed THz q-plate with a fixed rate of change of the optical axis
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We report the design and test of a THz dielectric q-plate realizing a fixed rate of change of the optical axis. The device consists of space-variant birefringent slabs manufactured by 3D printing using melt extruded ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene). The full position-dependent electric field of the THz beam propagating through the g-plate is obtained by measuring the THz time domain signal with a standard raster scan imaging routine. The E-field azimuthal and radial wave front patterns are successfully acquired from the realized q-plate.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Two-Dimensional Time-Domain Spectroscopy of Hydrogen-Like Impurity Centers in Germanium
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Coherence lifetimes (T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) of excited states of a hydrogen-like arsenic donor in germanium (Ge:As) have been determined by nonlinear two-dimensional (2D) ultrafast time-domain terahertz spectroscopy at cryogenic temperatures. The derived coherence times for the 2po and $2p\pm$ donor states are 2 ps and 0.15 ps respectively.

articleTitle: Longitudinal Phase-space Characterization of Electron Bunches with THz streaking and tomography
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Transverse streaking of electron bunches with laser-derived THz frequency sources offers potential for compact and very-high (femtosecond) time resolution characterization of electron beams. We consider, through modelling and experiment, the streaking of electron bunches in dielectric-lined waveguide structures where the THz and electron velocities are matched. THz frequency streaking has the advantage over established RF driven deflection techniques of extremely high streak rate for modest peak field strength. It however faces an additional challenge in interpretation when bunch durations comparable to the streak period. We develop and demonstrate tomography-like retrieval techniques which overcome this challenge and enable detailed retrieval of electron density with time with sub-100fs time resolution.

articleTitle: Infrared Focal Plane Assemblies for an All-Sky Spectral Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: This work presents three large-format 2048 x 2048 pixel arrays integrated into passively cooled assemblies able to image in the short and medium-wave infrared range. Continuous spectral selectivity is achieved by means of linear variable filters mounted above the detector arrays.

articleTitle: Transient multi-THz spectroscopy of single and multilayer 2D perovskite single crystals
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: With air-photonics THz platform, we investigated photo-induced carrier dynamics of single and multilayer 2D perovskite single crystals. Interesting novel features and physics are revealed with effective conductivity spectrum up to 12 THz and 40-fs time resolution.

articleTitle: LT-GaAs-based THz transceiver probe with active single-antenna for sub-50 μm spatial-resolution reflection measurements
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: The spatial resolution of photoconductive THz nearfield microprobes that are available for reflection operation has so far clearly lagged behind those for transmission operation. In this work, we present a THz near-field transceiver probe offering a spatial resolution increase from previously 200 μm now down to the sub-50-μm range. The increased resolution and high contrast is achieved by using a basically very old approach – an active single-antenna detector embedded on an LT-GaAs-based micro-cantilever. In contrast to the previous transceivers with a passive single antenna it enables an increased near-field interaction leading to increased contrast and spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Frequency-Resolved Focal Spot Size of a Two-Color Air-Plasma THz Beam
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Using knife-edge assisted THz time-domain spectroscopy with a broadband air-plasma THz source we demonstrate frequency-resolution of the spatial THz beam profile, most notably near the spectroscopically important focal plane.

articleTitle: THz gain measurements in optically pumped ammonia
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present experimental results about terahertz gain measurements in ammonia gas optically pumped by a quantum cascade laser. The gain was measured with the help of a vector network analyzer (VNA) and reached 17 dB/m at 1.07 THz.

articleTitle: Terahertz Time-Domain Ellipsometry of Heavily Doped β-Ga2 O3
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Heavily doped $\beta$-Ga$_{2} O_{3}$ single crystal was investigated using terahertz time-domain ellipsometry. $\beta$-Ga$_{2} O_{3}$ is anisotropic, hence, measurements were performed at different sample azimuthal angles. The optical properties were found to be largely influenced by the free carriers than the anisotropic background permittivity, and phonon effects were negligible in the measurement region. Drude model was then used to extract the carrier density and mobility parameters.

articleTitle: A 250 GHz Quasi-Optical Pulse Compressor with High Gain
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: A 250 GHz quasi-optical ring resonator/pulse compressor is presented. The ring consists of an input coupler and three mirrors. A low-loss semiconductor located in the ring provides the output coupling once irradiated by a laser. In the first tests with a 17 mW, 250 GHz source, 5.8 ns output pulses were generated with a power gain of 16. This is the first demonstration of a ring resonator/pulse compressor with high output power gain in the millimeter wave/THz regime. The resonator has many possible uses including applications at low power in spectroscopy and at high power in testing accelerator structures.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared photocurrent microscopy of vertical van der Waals semiconductor heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Van der Waals semiconductor heterostructures can be designed to absorb mid-infrared radiation, however the lateral size of exfoliated flakes (few micrometers) is just at the diffraction limit. We assembled a confocal IR microscope fed by a quantum cascade laser and we show preliminary photocurrent results on InSe/MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> at low temperature.

articleTitle: Fast THz-TDS Reflection Imaging with ECOPS scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We demonstrate high-speed terahertz time domain spectroscopy imaging in reflection configuration with use of electronically controlled optical sampling scheme. We employ Toptica TERAFLASH platform with fibre optic fed photoconductive switches (transmitter and receiver) based on InGaAs. The device can measure up to 1600 terahertz pulses per second. The fast movement of the sample was provided by two fast speed motorized linear stages. The acquisition of the 50 x 50 cm sample with resolution of 1.3 mm lasted about 14 minutes.

articleTitle: A Novel Reconfigurable Reflectarray With Single Bit For X-Band
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper, a reflection antenna element working in X band is designed. Reconfigurability of 1-bit phase is realized by PIN switch control circuit. The simulation results show that in 9.4GHz $\sim 11.9$ GHz frequency domain, the phase difference between the two phases reaches a stable 180 °. The structure adopts single-layer design, and the complexity and element performance are balanced.

articleTitle: Inhibition of cell division by THz irradiation
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Time-lapse morphological analysis of human cells under THz irradiation shows inhibition of cell division at cytokinesis. The contractile ring, which must disappear at the end of cell division remained for 1 hour under THz irradiation. This phenomenon was not reproduced by heating up the sample, indicating that this is non-thermal effect of the THz irradiation. We also observed induction of filamentous actin, which is the major component of contractile ring, during THz irradiation (460 GHz and 280 GHz). These results are in good agreement with previous in vitro experiments in which polymerization of actin protein was enhanced by THz irradiation.

articleTitle: Grating dielectric lens for terahertz multibeam
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In recent years, terahertz communication has grown rapidly, and the demand for terahertz multipoint communication is also increasing. This paper proposed a grating dielectric lens multi-beam antenna, which can flexibly adjust the beam direction by changing the grating period and height. As a demonstration, terahertz three-beam antenna is simulated and designed at 220 GHz. In the range of the grating period from 0.5um to 2.5um, the side beam from 22 degrees to nearly 90 degrees is controlled. This multibeam lens provides a solution for compact terahertz multibeam emission.

articleTitle: THz imaging based on beam engineering using spatial filtering methods
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Beam engineering based on compact diffractive optics and spatial filtering methods, like phase contrast and dark field, for THz imaging is presented. It is shown that spatial filtering enables enhancement in images contrast up to 30 dB, and an order of magnitude increased signal-to-noise ratio, opening thus a promising route for functional and versatile applications.

articleTitle: Raman scattering with near infrared excitation selectively resonant with the indirect bandgap of bulk MoSe2
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Resonance Raman scattering has proven extremely useful for the study of two-dimensional materials, as it provides information on both the electronic and vibrational excitations and on the coupling among them. Here we show that by employing infrared excitation energy we can identify the Raman resonance processes in MoSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> crystals, obtaining information on phonon modes away from $\Gamma$ point.

articleTitle: Study of the Origin of Quasi-Bound States in the Continuum
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: In this paper we simulate and experimentally verify the quasi Bound States in the Continuum in the far field Terahertz Domain. We also show the origin of the quasi-BIC states as function of the structural asymmetry.

articleTitle: On-chip broadband terahertz amplitude modulator based on GaAs-diodes
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An On-chip ultra broadband terahertz amplitude modulator based on GaAs-diodes is prenented in this paper. In this on-chip modulator, the microstructure is combined with semiconductor material to form the modulation unit. By controlling the resonance characteristic of the modulation unit, we realize the broadband modulation of terahertz waves. And We have experimentally demonstrated the modulation of terahertz waves in a wide frequency band (0.21 to 0.26 THz).

articleTitle: Multi-modes Orbital Angular Momentum Generator Enabled by the Metallic Holographic Mirror
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: An appealing method of multi-modes orbital angular momentum generator based on the metallic holographic mirror is proposed to generate up to 16 modes OAM beam is proposed. Katsenelenbaum-Semenov algorithm combined with the phase retrieval technique are used in the design to manipulate the phase change accurately. A proof-of-concept example is constructed at W-band to corroborate the validity of our methodology, and the results of simulations are in excellent agreement with theoretical predictions. Except for the multi-modes, the proposed features low-loss, high efficiency, and easy to processing.

articleTitle: Development of a terahertz wave band-stop filter using 2D arrays of metallic helices
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We developed a broadband terahertz wave band-stop filter using 2D arrays of metallic helices. We evaluated the performance of the filter using standard terahertz time domain spectroscopy and we obtained a transmittance of −30 dB in the frequency range of 117 – 208 GHz. This filter has a potential to be used in terahertz wave measurement systems.

articleTitle: Deterministic Superfocusing of terahertz waves in random media
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We present a theoretical demonstration of a novel approach to harness deterministic spatiotemporal control of ultrafast terahertz waves in random media. We utilise time-domain detection of terahertz fields using established state-of-the-art time-domain spectroscopy and demonstrate retrieval of coherent transfer matrix exploiting the recently emerging technique of nonlinear ghost imaging, which is a key challenge in photonics. Further, in combination with nonlinear ghost imaging, we retrieve complex-valued elements of coherent transfer matrix and achieve full spatiotemporal wave control using single-step constraint inversion to produce the desired-best fit of the transmitted terahertz waves through random media.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Subcycle Dynamics of Ultrastrong Light-Matter Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We investigate the nonlinearities of custom-tailored ultrastrongly light-matter coupled states by driving them with both the vacuum electromagnetic field and strong coherent THz waveforms. In this novel regime, where both the Rabi frequency induced by the coherent field and the vacuum Rabi frequency set by the cavity field are on the order of the carrier frequency of light, we observe strong subcycle pump-probe and multiwave mixing nonlinearities and nonlinear polariton correlations, violating the normal-mode approximation. Such custom-cut nonlinearities of hybridized excitations set the stage for nonlinear optical control of deep-strong coupling, exploring quantum phase transitions or nonclassical light sources.

articleTitle: Time-Resolved Nonlinear Ghost-Imaging for Terahertz 3D microscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Time-Resolved Nonlinear Ghost Imaging is a microscopy technique capable of extracting with fidelity the terahertz field scattered from an object plane with sub-wavelength resolution. In this presentation, we demonstrate that it enables the extraction of volumetric images in microscopic samples in real experimental conditions. © 2022 Olivieri et al.

articleTitle: Fano Resonance in THz Metasurface on Ultrathin Dielectric Substrates
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: Propagation of tangential electromagnetic modes in an array of split-ring resonators deposited on a thin dielectric plate is analyzed by studying the properties of the Fano resonance. We find a noticeable difference between diffracted modes in freestanding resonators and guided modes in the presence of a dielectric plate. We demonstrate that in the case of a subwavelength dielectric thickness, the tangential modes are guided by both interference and internal reflections of diffracted waves.

articleTitle: Road to the Tera-Photonics -50 years Progress and Prospects-
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: ”Road to the Tera-Photonics” for 50 years progress and prospects will be discussed.

articleTitle: Conduction Properties of Poly(ethylene oxide) Electrolytes with Lithium Salts at Terahertz Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
abstract: We study the conduction properties of solid-state polymer electrolytes based on cross-linked poly(ethylene oxide) with lithium salts, using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy at room temperature. The obtained terahertz conductivity spectra of the electrolytes and the associated ionic and molecular dynamics are found to be sensitive to the type and concentration of the added salt.

articleTitle: Coherent Emission from GaN Surface Relief Gratings with Different Filling Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 47th International Conference on Infrared, Millimeter and Terahertz Waves (IRMMW-THz)
